articleTitle: Recent advances in non-linear fiber propagation modeling
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Substantial advances in the modeling of non-linear fiber propagation have recently been made. Advantages and limitations of various proposed models are outlined and discussed. The still open problems and future challenges, including non-linearity mitigation, are discussed.

articleTitle: Open compute and networking approaches
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: OCP Network: Why does Facebook build network hardware and software? A radical approach to managing large-scale networks and its' impact on network architecture and technology.

articleTitle: Flexible coding and modulation techniques for next generation DSP-based coherent systems
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We compare recently reported techniques that enable flexible coding and modulation in coherent optical systems. We focus on methods that are feasible to incorporate in next generation DSP ASICs within two to three years.

articleTitle: Technical challenges in 100Gb/s SiP transceivers for data center applications
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Silicon photonics based VOAs (variable optical attenuators) have been manufactured for the past several years in quantities of 100,000s per year. How do the lessons of high-volume VOA production apply to 100Gb/s transceivers as the volumes also scale beyond 100k per year?

articleTitle: Requirements of inter data center networks to meet the explosive growth of cloud services
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Cloud networking bandwidth demand continues to surge. New technologies and architectures are required to meet this demand in an economically viable manner. The evolution of DC interconnect technologies and architectures are examined. Issues around disaggregation vs vertical integration and network virtualization are discussed.

articleTitle: Is there any new technology for optical datacenter interconnection?
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: For giant cloud players, the optical network is the basic solution for Data Center Interconnection (DCI). In this talk, I will discuss the optical DCI concerns and trends in my mind, basing on my experience as an optical network architect in Alibaba and Dahoo.

articleTitle: Twisted communications using orbital angular momentum
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: In this talk, we review recent research progress in twisted communications using orbital angular momentum (OAM). Basic concepts, key devices and techniques, free-space and fiber-based transmission links, and grooming functionalities of OAM communications are discussed.

articleTitle: Twisted communications using orbital angular momentum
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: In this talk, we review recent research progress in twisted communications using orbital angular momentum (OAM). Basic concepts, key devices and techniques, free-space and fiber-based transmission links, and grooming functionalities of OAM communications are discussed.

articleTitle: Hardening the SDN optical transport network security — Is it a pleonasm or oxymoron?
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: The communication industry must adapt to deal with SDN which is set to rewrite the book of networking. However, the main question remains if SDN improves the security or it makes such networks more vulnerable.

articleTitle: Operationalization of SDN: Progress and challenges
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Despite market demonstrations, SDN software and standards have signficant gaps that prevent pervasive deployments, especially in the WAN. This presentation presents the state and key challenges that need to be addressed.

articleTitle: Silicon-chip-based optical frequency combs
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Generation of optical frequency combs using Silicon-based photonics offers the potential for highly robust, compact, low-power devices for a wide range of applications in time and frequency metrology, sensing, spectroscopy, and communications.

articleTitle: Intra-datacenter network architecture
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Today's large scale data center networks are both massively scalable and highly resilient, typically using custom designed software and hardware. What factors drive the design, and how will they develop in the future?

articleTitle: Delta-sigma modulation for digital mobile fronthaul enabling carrier aggregation of 32 4G-LTE / 30 5G-FBMC signals in a single-λ 10-Gb/s IM-DD channel
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A delta-sigma modulation-based digital mobile fronthaul architecture is experimentally demonstrated to support carrier aggregation of 32 4G-LTE or 30 5G-FBMC signals in a single-λ IM-DD channel with capacity enhancement of 3-4 times compared with CPRI.

articleTitle: DAC-free ultra-low-power dual-polarization 64-QAM transmission with InP IQ segmented MZM module
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate for the first time 32 GBd 64-QAM signal generation without the usage of DACs. The dual-polarization 64-QAM signal is transmitted error-free over 80 km of SSMF with 7.8 pJ/bit record low energy consumption.

articleTitle: Impact of the transmitter IQ-skew in multi-subcarrier coherent optical systems
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We show that the impact of non-ideal time synchronization between in-phase and quadrature electrical signals can be critical in multi-subcarrier systems. We propose the use of an 8×8 real-valued butterfly equalizer structure to mitigate it.

articleTitle: Demonstration of optical transmission at bit rates of up to 321.4Gb/s using compact Silicon based modulator and linear BiCMOS MZM driver
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We have designed and tested a compact flip-chip assembly that combines the photonic and electrical functionality of a Silicon Photonic modulator and a SiGe BiCMOS MZM-driver. This forms the basis for low-cost advanced optical transceivers.

articleTitle: Service function chaining in multi-domain networks
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: The authors propose a vertex-centric distributed resource orchestration algorithm for finding all feasible mappings of a service function chain in multi-domain networks. Simulation results show superior efficiency and scalability for computing large service function chain requests.

articleTitle: Digital subcarrier multiplexed hybrid QAM for data-rate flexibility and ROADM filtering tolerance
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Novel digital subcarrier multiplexed (SCM) hybrid QAM scheme is proposed, demonstrating flexibility in data-rate and tolerance to optical filtering effects. SCM hybrid 150Gb/s signals show ~60% reach improvement in cascaded 37.5GHz ROADM filtering scenario.

articleTitle: A tunable hybrid III-V-on-Si MOS microring resonator with negligible tuning power consumption
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate a novel hybrid microring resonator with an integrated III-V-on-Si metal-oxide-semiconductor (MOS) capacitor structure for essentially zero-power resonance tuning. Over 1,000,000,000 times better tuning efficiency than conventional thermal tuning approach has been achieved.

articleTitle: Demonstration of dynamic restoration in segment routing multi-layer SDN networks
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Dynamic traffic recovery is designed and validated in a multi-layer network exploiting an SDN-based implementation of Segment Routing. Traffic recovery is locally performed from the node detecting the failure up to the destination node without involving the SDN controller. Experimental results demonstrate recovery time within 50 ms.

articleTitle: Mitigation of modal crosstalk-induced power fading in mode division multiplexed W-band RoF links
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: To avoid the modal crosstalk-induced power fading, a mode assignment technique has been proposed and experimentally demonstrated for mode division multiplexed W-band radio-over-fiber links.

articleTitle: End-to-end SDN orchestration of IoT services using an SDN/NFV-enabled edge node
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose an SDN/NFV-enabled edge node for IoT Services by means of orchestration of integrated Cloud/Fog and network resources. Network connectivity is provided between IoT gateways and deployed virtual machines allocated at the edge node.

articleTitle: Multi-mode optical fiber amplifier supporting over 10 spatial modes
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate a multimode cladding-pumped fiber amplifier that supports 10 modes with 2-dB mode-dependent gain, 20-dB gain, and 25-dBm output power. The mode-dependent gain is minimized using an oversized core supporting additional modes.

articleTitle: A novel WDM-MDM PON scheme utilizing self-homodyne detection for high-speed/capacity access networks
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose a cost-effective, energy savings WDM-MDM PON scheme utilizing self-homodyne detection for high-speed/capacity access network with low mode-crosstalk FMF and MUX/DEMUX. A proof of concept 4×40 Gb/s OFDM signal over 55 km FMF with error free operation was experimentally demonstrated.

articleTitle: Photonic integrated circuits: A study on process variations
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Developing an efficient method and applying it to study several identical microresonators fabricated by electron beam lithography, we quantify the worst-case within-die silicon thickness and resonance wavelength variations to be 1.55 and 2.11 nm, respectively.

articleTitle: Enhanced asymmetrically clipped optical ODFM for high spectral efficiency and sensitivity
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Using `musical' chords at octaves, EACO-OFDM increases ACO-OFDM's spectral efficiency to 87.5% of DC-biased OFDM, while providing a 7-dB SNR advantage for the same optical power. Nonlinear methods and matched filtering provide near theoretical performance.

articleTitle: WDM-PON preventive optical monitoring system with colourless reflectors
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A new optical monitoring system for remote measurement of fibre attenuation in WDM-PONs is reported. It uses colourless reflectors at ONU side, avoiding inventory complexity. Its performance is demonstrated with negligible penalty on 12.5Gb/s transmission.

articleTitle: Transceiver for NG-PON2: Wavelength tunablity for burst mode TWDM and point-to-point WDM
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Direct modulation of a 10-nm tunable DBR laser was used to demonstrate 20 km transmission, high fiber-coupled power operation (> 10 mW), low power consumption, and frequency stabilization in burst mode operation for the NGPON2 application.

articleTitle: High resolution automatic fault detection in a fiber optic link via photon counting OTDR
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We present an automatic method for detecting and evaluating fault events in a fibre link. Two Photon Counting OTDR setups are presented (3.5 cm, 12 dB and 2.25 m, 29 dB) allied to a signal processing technique for automatic results.

articleTitle: Silicon photonics: Silicon nitride versus silicon-on-insulator
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Silicon photonics typically builds on a silicon-on-insulator based high-index-contrast waveguide system. Silicon nitride provides an alternative moderate-index-contrast system that is manufacturable in the same CMOS environment. This paper discusses the relative benefits of both platforms.

articleTitle: Regenerator site selection in impairment-aware elastic optical networks
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose a novel regenerator site selection scheme for nonlinear impairment-aware elastic optical networks. The proposed scheme reduces bandwidth use by up to 40% in a realistic network by employing only 6 regenerator sites.

articleTitle: Wavelength conversion of Nyquist pol-mux QPSK superchannel using four-wave mixing in SOA
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate the polarization insensitive wavelength conversion of polarization-multiplexed Nyquist QPSK superchannel with an overall data rate of 200 Gb/s using four-wave mixing in a co-polarized pump and co-propagating configuration in a SOA.

articleTitle: Mode selective 10-mode multiplexer based on multi-plane light conversion
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We report a 10 spatial mode multiplexer based on the technique of Multi-Plane Light Conversion. The device shows average 4.4 dB insertion loss and 21 dB mode selectivity across the full C+L-band.

articleTitle: Experimental demonstration of 260-meter security free-space optical data transmission using 16-QAM carrying orbital angular momentum (OAM) beams multiplexing
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate a 260-meter security free-space optical data transmission link using orbital angular momentum (OAM) beams multiplexing and 16-ary quadrature amplitude modulation (16-QAM) signals. We study the beam wandering, power fluctuation, channel crosstalk, bit-error rate (BER) performance, and link security.

articleTitle: Agile micro- and millimeter-wave communication using photonic frequency conversion
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Broadband wireless transmission with tunable 5–40GHz carrier is demonstrated using photonic frequency conversion. The agile tuner allows ∼4 GHz of instantaneous bandwidth for both up- and down-conversion paths, without banding or channelization.

articleTitle: How can flexibility on the line side best be exploited on the client side?
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: High order digital coherent modulation schemes and adaptive modulation techniques allow flexible rate DWDM line transmission to maximize the transmission capacity of an optical path. We show that FlexE on the client side enables low cost DCI transport devices to take advantage of flexible rate line transmission without the need to incorporate scalable grooming fabrics in the transport device.

articleTitle: First real-time 400G PAM-4 demonstration for inter-data center transmission over 100 km of SSMF at 1550 nm
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Real-time transmission of 400G (8×50G DWDM) PAM-4 signals for data center interconnects up to 100 km SSMF is successfully demonstrated. All channels stay well below the 802.3bj KR4 FEC limit, thus allowing error free transmission.

articleTitle: Bidirectional 120 Gbps SDM-WDM-PON with colourless ONU using 10 Gbps optical components without DSP
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate an SDM-WDM-PON system with symmetric aggregated capacity of 120 Gbps (3×scores, 4×wavelengths, 10 Gbps each). The light sources are distributed through the center core of the 7-core fiber, facilitating colorless ONU.

articleTitle: Demonstration of an autonomous, software controlled living optical network that eliminates the need for pre-planning
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A “living network” is demonstrated, that, unlike today's static planning, adapts to varying network conditions, and allows operation close to performance limits. An autonomously operating test-bed shows feasibility with an allocated margin of only 1.5 dB.

articleTitle: Space-division multiplexing (SDM) technology for short-reach fiber optic systems
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Space-division-multiplexing, which can take many forms, provides low cost, high-bandwidth optical links for short-reach systems. We studied 2, 4 and 8-core multicore fiber (MCF) systems with associated connectors and fan-outs and achieved excellent BER performance.

articleTitle: Silicon photonics for 100G-and-beyond coherent transmissions
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We describe component and module performances of our silicon based photonic integrated circuits developed for 100G to 400G coherent transponders.

articleTitle: 6-Mode 19-core fiber for weakly-coupled mode-multiplexed transmission over uncoupled cores
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Design and fabrication results of a 6-mode 19-core fiber with the highest relative core multiplicity factor of 30 for weakly-coupled mode-multiplexed uncoupled-core-multiplexed transmission are detailed. Technical challenges for long-haul transmission are also discussed.

articleTitle: 55-GHz bandwidth short-cavity distributed reflector laser and its application to 112-Gb/s PAM-4
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A short-cavity distributed reflector (DR) laser achieved a 3-dB BW of 55 GHz. The DR laser was used to demonstrate single-channel 112-Gb/s PAM-4 transmission without pre-emphasis.

articleTitle: Bandwidth allocation scheme based on simple statistical traffic analysis for TDM-PON based mobile fronthaul
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose a bandwidth allocation scheme utilizing simple statistical traffic analysis for TDM-PON based mobile fronthaul. Experiments show that excess bandwidth allocation can be reduced while achieving latency under 50 μs.

articleTitle: A 2×2 MIMO optical wireless system at D-band
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate for the first time a 2×2 MIMO optical-wireless system at D-band. The maximum wireless distance is 4m. 32-Gb/s (8-Gbaud) bit rate can be further increased by adopting sufficient-bandwidth mm-wave amplifiers and mixers.

articleTitle: O, E, S, C, and L band silicon photonics coherent modulator/receiver
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We present a monolithic silicon photonic integrated circuit coherent modulator and receiver that works from 1260 to 1630 nm. We demonstrate 200-Gb/s unamplified 16-QAM transmission and long-range optical coherence tomography.

articleTitle: Converged mobile fronthaul and passive optical network based on hybrid analog-digital transmission scheme
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Fiber transmission of simultaneous 120×20 MHz LTE-like fronthaul signals for mobile users and 2.5 Gb/s baseband signal for wireline users are experimentally demonstrated for broadband access based on hybrid analog-digital transmission approach.

articleTitle: High speed TDM-PON beyond 10G
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We present and discuss options for increasing bitrate of TDM-PON beyond 10 Gbps. An overview of experimental results on 25 and 40 Gbps TDM-PON reported in literature is given.

articleTitle: Beam steered millimeter-wave fiber-wireless system for 5G indoor coverage
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A 38GHz beam steered fiber-wireless system, enabled by a novel integrated optical tunable delay line, is demonstrated for 5G indoor coverage. The beam steering gains 14dBm spatial power focusing and 6 times EVM improvement.

articleTitle: ContactLess integrated photonic probe: Concept, technology and applications
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We report on our recent achievements on the development of an integrated in-line transparent detector (CLIPP), enabling non-invasive on-chip monitoring of the light and robust feedback controlled schemes for high complexity photonic integrated circuits.

articleTitle: Programmable fiber-based arbitrary optical pulse-intensity shaper based on time-domain phase-only linear filtering
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A fiber-optic programmable picosecond pulse shaper is experimentally demonstrated using multi-level phase-only linear filtering in the time-domain, enabling the synthesis of high-quality, fully arbitrary temporal intensity profiles, including asymmetric waveforms and high-speed pulse-amplitude code sequences.

articleTitle: Multi-dimensional resource virtualization in spectral and spatial domains for inter-datacenter optical networks
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: This paper proposes multi-dimensional resource mapping algorithms for inter-datacenter optical networks. Simulation results show that these proposed mapping algorithms can achieve better performance in blocking probability and revenue-to-cost ratio than the baseline algorithm.

articleTitle: Capacity-approaching transmission over 6375 km at spectral efficiency of 8.3 bit/s/Hz
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Transmission capacities of 34.9Tb/s over 6375 km based on Gaussian-like DP-64APSK and 33.3 Tb/s over 6800 km using DP-32QAM are demonstrated using hybrid spans with quasi-single-mode fiber. Nonlinear compensation enables 8.3 b/s/Hz spectral efficiency.

articleTitle: 54 Gbps OOK transmission using single mode VCSEL up to 1 km OM4 MMF
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Successful 54 Gbps OOK transmission over 1 km of multimode OM4 fibre is demonstrated. The decisive advantages of the single mode over multimode VCSEL in transmission experiments are shown.

articleTitle: Solutions for future mobile fronthaul and access-network convergence
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Presents a collection of slides covering the following topics: trend of broadband services; typical network configuration; mobile communication evolution; current fronthaul solutions; IQ-data compression; fronthaul with WDM; massive MIMO; functional split; cooperation with PON; access network virtualization; coexistence scenario.

articleTitle: Single carrier high symbol rate transmitter for data rates up to 1.0 Tb/s
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate an all-electronically multiplexed, single optical carrier, flexible rate transmitter based on a high-speed 3-bit multiplexer and analog-to-digital converter integrated circuit. Line rates up to 1.08 Tb/s are obtained using 90 Gbd PDM-64QAM.

articleTitle: Adaptive digital pre-emphasis for high speed digital analogue converters
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: An adaptive digital pre-emphasis to mitigate the electrical bandwidth limitation of high speed DACs is proposed. Numerical simulations prove its effectiveness for QPSK, 16QAM and 64QAM, by significantly increasing the transmittable symbol rate.

articleTitle: CPRI-compatible efficient mobile fronthaul transmission via equalized TDMA achieving 256 Gb/s CPRI-equivalent data rate in a single 10-GHz-bandwidth IM-DD channel
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose and experimentally demonstrate a CPRI-compatible efficient mobile fronthaul scheme for synchronous transmission of control words and IQ data via equalized TDMA, achieving 256 Gb/s CPRI-equivalent data rate in a 10-GHz-bandwidth IM-DD channel.

articleTitle: Evaluation of elastic modulation gains in microsoft's optical backbone in North America
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We study Q-factor and its variation in Microsoft's backbone network carrying live traffic. We find that a capacity gain of at least 70% is achievable via elastic modulation.

articleTitle: Single-mode 1.5-μm VCSELs with 22-GHz small-signal bandwidth
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate an ultra-short cavity 1.5-μm single-mode directly-modulated VCSELs with record modulation bandwidth of 22 GHz at room temperature operation.

Index Terms: Singlemode Vertical Cavity Surface Emitting Lasers

articleTitle: Micro-bend-resistant low-DMGD 6-LP-mode fiber
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We report the design and the fabrication of a low differential-mode-group-delay 6-LP-mode fiber with a micro-bending sensitivity lower than that of standard SMFs. This fiber also exhibits low mode coupling which improves differential-mode-group-delay compensation.

articleTitle: Experimental demonstration of CPRI data compression based on partial bit sampling for mobile front-haul link in C-RAN
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate CPRI data compression based on a partial bit sampling and compare its performance with other compression methods. Very low compression delay and EVM degradation less than 3.2 μsec and 0.2% are presented.

articleTitle: Demonstration of elastic optical network node with defragmentation functionality and SDN control
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose and demonstrate an elastic optical network node with defragmentation functionality and novel software-defined networking (SDN)-based control scheme. Experimental results of extended OpenFlow messages and signal performance validate the overall feasibility.

articleTitle: Ultra low-loss optical fiber technology
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Since inception silica based optical fibers have demonstrated dramatic attenuation reduction from 20 dB/km to 0.1460 dB/km. Ultra-low level of attenuation is enabled by silica core fiber design and reduction of the largest attenuation component - Rayleigh scattering.

articleTitle: Towards a fast centralized controller for integrated silicon photonic multistage MZI-based switches
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: An FPGA-based centralized controller architecture for silicon photonics MZI-based switches is experimentally demonstrated achieving scheduling decision in one clock cycle. To counter process variation affecting the switching bias voltages, a pulse-width modulation technique is presented.

articleTitle: In-band OSNR monitors comprising programmable delay line interferometer integrated with wavelength selective switch by spatial and planar optical circuit
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose a novel delay line interferometer and demonstrate its application to in-band OSNR monitors integrated with wavelength selective switches (WSSs). The WSS-integrated monitors are capable of detecting OSNR with 1.2-dB accuracy.

articleTitle: GaAs0.5Sb0.5/InP UTC-PD with graded-bandgap collector for zero-bias operation at sub-THz regime
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: By using type-II absorption-collector interface and graded-bandgap collector in UTC-PDs for zero-bias operation, such photodiode achieves record 3-dB O-E bandwidth (140 GHz) and sub-THz output power (-13.9dBm at 160GHz) among all the reported zero-bias photodiodes.

articleTitle: Optimized 4 and 8 dimensional modulation formats for variable capacity in optical networks
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We present enhanced modulation formats optimized for nonlinear performance over a range of spectral efficiency. Maximum transmission distance is improved by > 600 km at PM-8QAM capacity and by > 3500 km at PM-BPSK rates.

articleTitle: Ten-channel discrete multi-tone modulation using silicon microring modulator array
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We report ten-channel discrete multi-tone generation using silicon microring modulator array, which simultaneously function as de-multiplexers, modulators, and multiplexers. An aggregated data rate of 0.88 Tb/s is achieved at a bit error ratio of 3.8×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-3</sup>.

articleTitle: Vendor-neutral network representations for transport SDN
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We describe a model-based approach for building a transport SDN platform that uses operator-defined data models to build common APIs for managing multi-vendor optical networks consisting of terminal devices and line systems.

articleTitle: Experimental demonstration of an OCT-based precoding scheme for visible light communications
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose an orthogonal circulant matrix transform (OCT) based precoding scheme for VLC and experimentally demonstrate 400-Mb/s transmission over 1-m. The scheme outperforms conventional DFT-precoding and exhibits significantly reduced complexity than the adaptive loading scheme.

articleTitle: Kerr-induced nonlinearity reduction in coherent optical OFDM by low complexity support vector machine regression-based equalization
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate 7-dB reduction of nonlinearity penalty in 40-Gb/s CO-OFDM at 2000-km using support vector machine regression-based equalization. Simulation in WDM-CO-OFDM shows up to 12-dB enhancement in Q-factor compared to linear equalization.

articleTitle: Power efficient DSP implementation for 100G-and-beyond multi-haul coherent fiber-optic communications
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We review technology advancement in our three generations of coherent DSP implemented with 40, 20, and 16-nm CMOS technologies. The latest 16-nm implementation achieves sub-10-watt per 100 Gb/s transport for emerging data-center interconnect application.

articleTitle: Backscattering effect of phosphor diffuser on the blue laser diode based 5.2-Gbps Li-Fi communication link
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A laser diode (LD) based Li-Fi transmitter using phosphor diffuser diverged 450-nm blue LD for white-lighting and 5.2-Gbit/s OFDM with EVM of 17.3%, SNR of 15.3 dB and FEC qualified BER of 3.1×10-3 is demonstrated.

articleTitle: Hierarchical SDN orchestration of wireless and optical networks with E2E provisioning and recovery for future 5G networks
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: This paper proposes the hierarchical SDN orchestration of heterogeneous wireless/optical networks. End-to-End connectivity services are provisioned through different network segments by means of a Transport API. The hierarchical approach allows scalability, modularity and more security.

articleTitle: Wide dynamic range burst-mode digital coherent detection using fast ALC-EDFA and pre-calculation of FIR filter coefficients
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Proposed burst-mode coherent detection scheme successfully receives 20 Gb/s SP-QPSK burst frames with preamble of 1.3 ms, transmitted over 40 km SMF, at high sensitivity of -44.7 dBm with wide dynamic range of 21.7 dB.

articleTitle: 50km Error free transmission of fully integrated chirp-managed 10Gb/s directly modulated C-band tunable III-V/SOI hybrid lasers
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: 10Gb/s directly modulated tunable lasers, integrating chirp management ring resonators, have been designed and fabricated using wafer bonding. Using such a device, we demonstrated error-free transmission over 50km single mode fiber.

articleTitle: All-spectrum fiber-wireless transmission for 5G backhaul and fronthaul links
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: This paper presents the simultaneous transmission of millimeter-wave and terahertz-wave radio signals over an optical fiber and air by a single optical frequency comb source with several types of receiver configurations.

articleTitle: Polarization activity monitoring of an aerial fiber link in a live network
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We present state of polarization measurements from long-term monitoring of a 750-km aerial fiber. Polarization rotation rate and magnitude of the polarization change were recorded for more than 1330 hours over 22 months.

articleTitle: Fused type fan-out device for multi-core fiber based on bundled structure
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A fused type fan-out device for 7-core fiber was newly developed with no taper structure. A highly accurate core arrangement can be easily achieved. Consequently, an average splice loss of only 0.31 dB was obtained.

articleTitle: Investigation of FBMC in mobile fronthaul networks for 5G wireless with time-frequency modulation adaptation
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We compared OFDM and filter-bank multicarrier (FBMC) with time-frequency modulation adaptation in a centralized fiber-wireless integrated mobile fronthaul system supporting 5G. Experimental results demonstrate that FBMC outperforms OFDM with higher throughput and better modulation-adaptation performance.

articleTitle: Substrate removed silicon Mach-Zehnder modulator for high baud rate optical intensity modulations
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate a substrate-removed silicon Mach-Zehnder modulator with the 3-dB electro-optical bandwith beyond 50 GHz. Based on this modulator, 80 Gb/s on-off-keying and 50 Gbaud PAM-4 optical modulations are experimentally achieved without electrical pre-equlization.

articleTitle: High-density multicore fibers
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: High-density single-mode multicore fibers were designed and fabricated. A heterogeneous 30-core fiber realized a low crosstalk of -55 dB. A quasi-single-mode homogeneous 31-core fiber attained the highest core count as a single-mode multicore fiber.

articleTitle: Employing wavelength diversity technique to enhance the Brillouin gain response in BOTDA system
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: In this paper, we propose a novel wavelength diversity technique in Brillouin optical time domain analysis (BOTDA) system to improve the Brillouin gain response and increase sensing range. This technique greatly maximizes the launching pump power, without activating the nonlinear effects that limit the conventional BOTDA sensing range. The strain and temperature effects on Brillouin frequency shift have been characterized in the proposed technique with an extended sensing range up to 100 km and 1 meter spatial resolution.

articleTitle: Reconfigurable optical dragonfly architecture for high performance computing
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We present a reconfigurable dragonfly architecture for High-Performance-Computing (HPC) systems leveraging optical-circuit-switching. An SDN control plane monitors network traffic characteristics and optimizes the connectivity. Software-controlled reconfiguration of the optically interconnected topology is experimentally demonstrated.

articleTitle: Dynamic resource allocation for all-optical multicast based on sub-tree scheme in elastic optical networks
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: All-optical multicasting with a single light-tree suffers inefficient distance-adaptive spectrum allocation from its large tree-spanning size. We propose a routing modulation format and spectrum allocation (RMSA) algorithm based on sub-tree scheme to improve spectrum utilization.

articleTitle: 107.5 Gb/s 850 nm multi- and single-mode VCSEL transmission over 10 and 100 m of multi-mode fiber
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: First time successful 107.5 Gb/s MultiCAP 850 nm OM4 MMF transmissions over 10 m with multi-mode VCSEL and up to 100 m with single-mode VCSEL are demonstrated, with BER below 7% overhead FEC limit measured for each case.

articleTitle: A fully-blind fractionally-oversampled frequency domain adaptive equalizer
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A frequency domain adaptive equalizer, operating with fewer than 2 Sa/Symbol is investigated. Steady state performance and dynamic operation are demonstrated without equalizer training. We find that the equalizer exhibits no penalty as low as 1.1 Sa/Symbol.

articleTitle: 2×2 multimode interference coupler with low loss using 248 nm photolithography
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate a 2×2 multimode interference coupler in 220 nm silicon photonics, with 3.8 μm by 152 μm footprint. Loss is <0.15±0.01 dB for 1530–1565 nm, across the 200 mm wafer using 248 nm lithography. This is the lowest loss reported for sub-micron silicon 2×2 MMI.

articleTitle: Increasing flexibility and capacity in real PON deployments by using 2/4/8-PAM formats
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Current PONs use OOK throughout the network regardless of actual path losses. Flexible 4/8-PAM for better-situated ONUs can significantly increase the aggregated data rate, without expensive optics investment. 8-PAM is made feasible with zero-overhead data-aided-equalization.

articleTitle: Unscented Kalman filters for polarization state tracking and phase noise mitigation
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Joint polarization-state and phase noise tracking is demonstrated using an unscented Kalman filter. Experimentally this outperforms CMA and extended Kalman filters (EKF) and a less complex modified version outperforms CMA and EKF at higher OSNRs.

articleTitle: IEEE 100 Gb/s EPON
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Today's optical access network technologies will run out of capacity in 4-5 years assuming the continuing exponential increases in peak bandwidth demand. This paper discusses the next generation of IEEE optical access, the 100 Gb/s Ethernet Passive Optical Network (EPON), capable of reaching bit rates of 100 Gb/s.

articleTitle: A computationally efficient shift-register based information scrambling approach to physical layer security in MIMO-SDM systems
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We show that a computationally efficient information scrambler based on a simple linear feedback shift register (LFSR) can establish perfect physical layer security in multiple-input-multiple-output space-division multiplexing (MIMO-SDM), with negligible penalty for the legitimate receiver.

articleTitle: 24 to 34-Gb/s ×4 multi-rate VCSEL-based optical transceiver with referenceless CDR
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A high-density multi-rate VCSEL transceiver with CDRs was developed. We succeed in suppressing the jitter of optical link by developing CDR for the receiver, and realized a 24 to 34-Gb/s x4 interconnect with retime function.

articleTitle: >25 Gbps direct modulation and data transmission with 1310 nm waveband wafer fused VCSELs
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: 25 Gb/s transmission over 10 km of standard single mode fiber is demonstrated for 1300 nm wafer fused InP/GaAs VCSELs with increased strain in quantum wells and higher output coupling from the cavity.

articleTitle: Doubling the ROADM sites using pairwise coding for 4%-guard-band superchannels
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose pairwise coding to enhance a superchannel's tolerance to non-idea ROADM filtering effect. Experimental results show that the number of ROADMs can be double in links with 4% guard-band superchannels.

articleTitle: Subcarrier index-power modulated optical OFDM (SIPM-OOFDM) for IMDD PON systems
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: SIPM-OOFDM having an extra subcarrier index-power information-bearing dimension is, for the first time, proposed and investigated, which, compared to conventional OOFDM, offers considerable signal transmission capacity improvement without degrading system power budget and dispersion/nonlinearity tolerances.

articleTitle: Low-loss and misalignment-tolerant fiber-to-chip edge coupler based on double-tip inverse tapers
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A novel fiber-to-chip edge coupler with two tapered tips and a multimode interference combiner is demonstrated on a silicon-on-insulator platform. It has advantages over a single-tip edge coupler on coupling loss, bandwidth and misalignment tolerance.

articleTitle: A low complexity hybrid time-frequency domain adaptive equalizer for coherent optical receivers
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A low complexity hybrid adaptive equalization technique, combining frequency domain filtering and multiplier-free time domain filter tap weight updates is proposed and experimentally verified. No notable penalty is observed versus the conventional time domain equalizer.

articleTitle: Density evolution and error floor analysis for staircase and braided codes
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We analyze deterministically constructed (i.e., non-ensemble-based) codes in the waterfall and error floor region. The analysis directly applies to several FEC classes proposed for high-speed OTNs such as staircase and braided codes.

articleTitle: Independently self-calibrated frequency response measurements of high-speed modulators and photodetectors with same setup
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A self-calibrated method based on the frequency-shifted heterodyne scheme is proposed and demonstrated for independent frequency response measurement of high-speed Mach-Zehnder modulators (MZMs), phase modulators (PMs) and photodetectors (PDs) with the same setup.

articleTitle: Multidimensional modulation and coding
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We discuss how error-correction coding and modulation can be cooptimized, how modulation formats can be interpreted as codes, and the roles of soft and hard decision decoding.

articleTitle: The limits of the nonlinear Shannon limit
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Recent results about information theoretical limits in optical fibers are reviewed and the significance of what is commonly known as the nonlinear Shannon limit discussed. It is shown that this limit can be improved, while the actual channel capacity at high powers still remains substantially unknown.

articleTitle: XPolM compensation by two-stage phase recovery for baud-rate optimized nonlinear transmission
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A novel XPolM compensation is proposed for baud-rate optimized transmission. Q-factor for PM-16QAM is 0.2 dB and 0.3 dB improved, respectively in dispersion-uncompensated and dispersion-managed links, reducing 65~80% averaging window size against the conventional method.

articleTitle: Data-rate figure of merit for physical layer in fixed-grid reconfigurable optical networks
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose a Monte-Carlo method to establish the merit of physical layer in transparent optical networks as average bit-rate per lightpath at full load and consider two transmission techniques and impact of nonlinear fiber propagation.

articleTitle: Pump-to-signal cross-polarization scattering in coherent dual-polarized systems with forward Raman amplification
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate that pump-to-signal cross-polarization scattering represents an impairment that limits the amount of forward Raman pumping used in polarization-multiplexed coherent systems. We also develop and validate experimentally an analytical noise model for the impairment.

articleTitle: Low-penalty up to 16-QAM wavelength conversion in a low loss CMOS compatible spiral waveguide
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Wavelength conversion of 32-Gbaud QPSK and 10-Gbaud 16-QAM is demonstrated using a 50-cm long low loss spiral Hydex-glass waveguide. BER < HD-FEC threshold is achieved over 10 nm bandwidth with OSNR penalty < 0.5 dB.

articleTitle: Fiber-optic communication using fast Nonlinear Fourier transforms
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Nonlinear Fourier transforms (NFTs) are beginning to draw attention in fiber-optic communications. This has recently led to the development of the first fast NFT algorithms. In this paper, these developments are reviewed.

articleTitle: Capacity improvement using dual-carrier FEC gain sharing in submarine optical communications
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Dual-carrier SD-FEC gain sharing is utilized as a nonlinearity mitigation strategy for coherent super-channels in the context of submarine communications. Up to 0.68 dB benefit in Q and 50% more capacity is demonstrated.

articleTitle: Faster return of investment in WDM networks when elastic transponders dynamically fit ageing of link margins
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We illustrate the cost reduction during 10-year life of a core WDM network enabled by elastic transponders when accounting directly for end-of-life OSNR detection margins, compared to margins progressively growing with network ageing.

articleTitle: Silicon photonics integrated 16-QAM modulator exploiting only binary driving electronics
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A silicon photonics integrated reconfigurable nested Mach-Zehnder interferometer including tunable splitters and four independent phase modulators has been designed and fabricated. Thanks to the custom architecture, 16-QAM modulation is achieved with simple binary driving signals and successfully detected up to 20Gbaud with BER below the FEC level.

articleTitle: Availability-guaranteed virtual optical network mapping with selective path protection
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We analyze the availability of virtual optical networks mapped over a physical substrate and propose VON mapping algorithms with selective dedicated protection to minimize cost while meeting availability requirements.

articleTitle: Simultaneous all-optical transparent phase multiplexing/de-multiplexing based on FWM in a HNLF
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose and experimentally demonstrate a novel bidirectional modulation format converter that can simultaneously phase multiplex and de-multiplex PSK signals between QPSK and BPSK formats all-optically by employing four-wave mixing (FWM) in a single HNLF.

articleTitle: First experimental demonstration of a distributed cloud and heterogeneous network orchestration with a common Transport API for E2E services with QoS
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A common Transport API is proposed for joint cloud/network orchestration, allowing interworking of heterogeneous control planes to provide provisioning/recovery of QoS-aware E2E services. We present its first demonstration in a multi-partner testbed including data-plane monitoring.

articleTitle: Experimental demonstration of heterogeneous cross stratum broker for scientific applications
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose and demonstrate cross-stratum Broker orchestration for scientific applications and heterogeneous resources reservation in DCs, HPC facilities and networks belonging to different operators. Experiments were performed in a distributed set-up spanning across three continents.

articleTitle: Attojoule optoelectronics — Requirements and prospects for low energy devices
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Using optics to save energy in information processing and communications will be increasingly important for continued scaling No other physical technology arguably has comparable potential for reducing communication energy and energy reduction is essential There are orders of magnitude of headroom for reducing the energy of optoelectronic systems through ➢ tight integration of optoelectronic devices, nanoscale optics, and electronics ➢ system redesign for minimum total energy per bit ➢ attojoule optoelectronic devices on micron and submicron scales Emerging possibilities for “zero dissipation” self-configuring optical processors could save additional energy in sensing, processing and communications.

articleTitle: Electrical injection locking of a fully integrated photonic integrated circuit based heterodyne source
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We report the stabilization of a 5 GHz signal generated from a fully integrated heterodyne photonic source. The demonstration differs from previous work as it uses only optoelectronic elements integrated in the photonic circuit. We have mutually correlate the phase noise of each integrated DFB and we stabilize the RF beating on the external reference using frequency comb generation and cross injection locking.

articleTitle: Silicon-based on-chip microdisk resonators for integrated microwave photonic applications
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We report two novel on-chip microdisk resonators exhibiting a single whispering-gallery-mode operation. By weakening the interaction between the confined light and the side-walls, the Q-factor is elevated. Their applications in integrated microwave photonics are discussed.

articleTitle: YANG model and NETCONF protocol for control and management of elastic optical networks
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: This paper proposes a YANG model to describe a sliceable transponder with variable rate, code, modulation formats, and monitoring capabilities. The model is introduced into NETCONF, which is experimentally demonstrated in a testbed.

articleTitle: Real-time 200 Gb/s 8-QAM transmission over a 1800-km long SSMF-based system using add/drop 50 GHz-wide filters
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate error-free transmission over 1800 km with 1 dB Q2-margins using a commercially available real-time 200 Gb/s PDM-8QAM transponder (44.8 GBaud) in a super-channel with carriers spaced by 50 GHz using legacy 50GHz-mux-demux stages.

articleTitle: All-optical digital network coding for very high-throughput mm-wave Fiber-Wireless networks
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We realized an all-optical digital physical-layer network coding in Fiber-Wireless networks by employing two SOA-MZI XOR gates. Encoding and decoding operations are demonstrated for 1Gb/s data on 10GHz subcarrier and extended to 60GHz with simulations.

articleTitle: A high-speed photodetector for telecom, ethernet, and FTTH applications in zero-change CMOS process
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A high-speed photodetector based on absorption by the defect states in transistor gate polysilicon is demonstrated with 0.14-0.2 A/W responsively in 1310-1610 nm and 10 GHz bandwidth in an unmodified 45 nm SOI CMOS process.

articleTitle: Nyquist-WDM channel generation using an arrayed waveguide grating router
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose a method for generating Nyquist sine pulses, based on an arrayed waveguide grating router (AWGR) preceded by a multimode interference coupler. This outperforms previous methods using a chirped AWGR and a dispersive fiber.

articleTitle: A 60-GHz RoF system employing variable step size LMS equalizer with fast convergence speed
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A 60-GHz RoF system transmitting 5-Gbps BPSK signal employing LMS equalizer is experimentally demonstrated. Results prove that the variable-step-size LMS equalizer can significantly enhance the BER performance of the system with faster convergence speed.

articleTitle: Advantages of strong mode coupling for suppression of nonlinear distortion in few-mode fibers
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Nonlinear distortion in few-mode fibers for intermediate coupling is studied for the first time. Coupling strengths beyond -20 dB/100m give suppression of nonlinear distortion below the isolated mode without mode coupling.

articleTitle: Compact few-mode fiber collimator and associated optical components for mode division multiplexed transmission
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We present a compact low-loss few-mode fiber collimator with low mode-dependent loss (<;0.3dB) and low modal crosstalk (<;-16.8dB). By incorporating additional optical elements various functional components can be realized providing almost identical performance for all modes.

articleTitle: Board mount client optics — Prospects and challenges
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Embedded optics are used in HPC, servers & routers, and, possibly, mega datacenters. They provide advantages in density, signal integrity, thermal management and cost over pluggable alternatives. This paper will address challenges in next generation implementations.

articleTitle: Components towards a photonics aided THz vector network analyzer
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Photomixing Terahertz systems become competitive with electronic systems in terms of dynamic range. This paves the road for photonic vector network analyzers. Key components like telecom-wavelength lasers and compatible THz sources and detectors are discussed.

articleTitle: Direct 3D nanoprinting on fiber tip of collimating lens and OAM mode converter in one compound element
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We utilize 3D nano printing process with two photon polymerization directly on optical fiber tip. A collimating lens with added azimuthal phase is used in attempt to generate free space OAM mode beam.

articleTitle: In-line optical signal multiplexing by polarization-insensitive fiber frequency conversion
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose a polarization-insensitive distributed all-optical subcarrier multiplexing by fiber frequency conversion using two orthogonally-polarized local subcarrier signals. Its effect is demonstrated by in-line signal addition at multiplexing node with less than 0.5-dB polarization dependence.

articleTitle: Optical static RAM cell using a monolithically integrated InP Flip-Flop and wavelength-encoded signals
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate successful optical static RAM cell operation with READ/WRITE at 5Gbps and I/O wavelength diversity capabilities. The RAM cell incorporates an integrated SOA-MZI Access Gate and a monolithic InP Flip-Flop with coupled switches.

articleTitle: All-optical tag comparator for 10Gb/s WDM-enabled optical cache memory architectures
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate an optical tag comparator for optical cache memory peripheral circuitry that decides upon cache “hit” or “miss” controlling the access of a 4-bit WDM-encoded optical word at 10Gb/s line-rate into a cache line.

articleTitle: From GMPLS to transport SDN
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: GMPLS was introduced in 1999-2000. Considerable investments into GMPLS have been made since then. These investments can be protected: through an evolution process GMPLS can make its way into transport SDN.

articleTitle: Discrete multi-tone transmission for short-reach optical connections
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: An overview of DMT modulation in short-reach, optical intensity-modulated and direct-detection channel is presented and impairments limiting DMT performance, such as clipping distortion, quantization noise, and thermal noise are introduced and discussed.

articleTitle: Broker-based multi-task gaming to facilitate profit-driven network orchestration in multi-domain SD-EONs
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose a novel network framework to facilitate multi-broker based network orchestration in multi-domain SD-EONs. With the framework, the brokers can compete for a bundle of request-provisioning tasks with an effective bidding strategy to maximize their profits.

articleTitle: Progressive recovery of virtual infrastructure services in optical cloud networks after large disasters
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: This paper studies progressive recovery in optical cloud substrates supporting virtualized infrastructure services. Several resource placement/scheduling schemes are presented to improve post-fault recovery and also evaluated against a baseline scheme.

articleTitle: Multi-channel all-optical signal processing based on parametric effects
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Two different experiments that use parametric effects for the processing of multiple signals in a single fiber are reviewed. The first experiment uses optical phase conjugation to mitigate the effects of nonlinearity in transmission, whereas the second uses multiple phase-sensitive amplifiers to regenerate six different channels.

articleTitle: On-demand virtual infrastructure composition over multi-domain and multi-technology networks
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: An experimental demonstration of a mechanism that composes on-demand virtual infrastructures over multi-domain multi-technology transport networks is presented. The integration of a virtualization and replanning algorithms within an end-to-end orchestration and virtualization platform is proposed.

articleTitle: Wavelength locking platform for DML-based multichannel transmitter on a silicon chip
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We present a platform for the feedback control of a multichannel transmitter based on DML sources and a silicon photonic multiplexer and carver circuit. Automatic tuning and wavelength locking are demonstrated in about 150 ms.

articleTitle: Frequency synthesis with chip-scale microresonators
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We describe the generation of low-noise optical and microwave signals via Kerr and Brillouin nonlinearities in high-quality-factor optical microresonators. Applications to clocks, timing, communications and sensing are discussed.

articleTitle: Silicon photonics for microwave photonics applications
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We describe the use of silicon photonics to develop integrated microwave photonics components and subsystems for generating chirped microwave and millimeter wave pulses as well as for providing optical delays and phase shifting for photonic beamforming.

articleTitle: Alignment and integration of a hybrid, external-cavity InP-SOI laser
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A 1550nm external-cavity hybrid III-V/SOI laser with a room-temperature threshold current of 18mA and output powers up to 4mW was demonstrated with a novel assembly technique. An edge-coupled 1×6 laser array was passively aligned with sub-micron positional tolerance.

articleTitle: Digital signal processing in optical communications from Long-haul to Data-centre
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A collection of slides from the author's conference presentation is given. Topics include: long-haul, metro and data-centre networks; coherent/direct-detection; modulation techniques; pulse amplitude modulation; discrete multi-tone (DMT); coherent transceivers; compensation methods; analogue filters; digital filters; MLSE.

articleTitle: Optimized brillouin frequency distributions for SBS suppression in active fibers
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Optimized distributions of the local Brillouin frequency to increase the SBS threshold in active fibers are derived analytically. Theoretical results on SBS suppression in fiber amplifiers for arbitrary gain distributions are shown.

articleTitle: Field experiment of OSNR-aware adaptive optical transmission with pilot-aided bidirectional feedback channel
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: An OSNR-aware adaptive optical transmission system using time-division-multiplexed pilot sequences is proposed. We successfully demonstrated that the system automatically optimizes signal form by using in-band OSNR estimation and a bidirectional feedback channel in filed-installed fiber.

articleTitle: Multi-channel wavelength/mode-division-multiplexers on silicon
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Recent progresses for compact silicon-based wavelength/mode-division-multiplexers are reported. Hybrid (de)multiplexers with multiple wavelengths, dual-polarizations, as well as multiple mode are also discussed to enable many channels for high-capacity optical interconnects.

articleTitle: Active stateful PCE high-availability for the control of flexi-grid networks with network function virtualization enabled replication
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We present, implement and validate an architecture for PCE high-availability combining the virtualization of the control function by means of dynamic replicas and the synchronization of their internal state using the PCEP and BGP-LS protocols.

articleTitle: A novel sharply bent silicon multimode waveguide with ultrahigh mode extinction ratio
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose a sharply bent (5 μm) multimode Silicon waveguide with mode extinction ratio over 22.8 dB from 1500 to 1600nm. A comparable performance can be achieved compared with conventional scheme with 40 μm radius.

articleTitle: Wavelength selective switch with optimal steering element utilization
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We implement a free-space unitary transform inside a wavelength selective switch to produce rectangular shaped beams on the LCoS steering element. Compared to standard Gaussian illumination, the WSS can support 2× as many ports per pixel.

articleTitle: Thermo-mechanical analysis of a cantilever mode converter between single-mode fiber and Si waveguide
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We study temperature-induced stresses and misalignments in a cantilevered mode converter used to couple light between single-mode fiber and a PIC. We show that the design with UV-cured epoxy as index-matching clad exhibits higher stresses and larger displacements.

articleTitle: Network cost savings enabled by probabilistic shaping in DP-16QAM 200-Gb/s systems
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We evaluate potential network cost savings enabled by probabilistic shaping in DP-16QAM 200-Gb/s systems, based on experimental measurements and analytical derivations. The results indicate savings of up to 6.7% in the average number of transceivers.

articleTitle: A compact 2.5D stacked transmitter for parallel optical interconnects
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: 2.5D silicon interposer, for a cost effective optoelectronic package, is proposed and fabricated on a wafer level. Using this packaging approach, the fully assembled 120 Gb/s transmitter is scaled down to 6mm × 7mm.

articleTitle: WDM transmission of twelve 960 Gb/s channels based on 120-GBaud ETDM PDM-16QAM over 1200-km TeraWave™ fiber link
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We have successfully demonstrated generation of 120-GBaud ETDM PDM-16QAM signals and transmission of twelve WDM channels, each with 960 Gb/s signals (800 Gb/s net data rate), over 1200-km link based on 100-km TeraWave™ fiber spans.

articleTitle: Investigation of applications of single-mode optical switch in multi-mode fiber deployed data center
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose a scheme of using single-mode fiber optical circuit switches in multi-mode fiber deployed data center with single mode transceivers. The insertion loss, modal dispersion and power penalty are examined.

articleTitle: Experimental analysis of non linear tolerance dependency of multicarrier modulations versus number of WDM channels
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We report on the non linear tolerance of multicarrier modulation versus the size of the WDM bandwidth. At high bandwidth efficiency, our results indicate that the gain of multicarrier is dependent on the WDM bandwidth.

articleTitle: Field trial demonstration of novel optical superchannel capacity protection for 400G using DP-16QAM and DP-QPSK with in-service OTDR fault localization
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A novel optical superchannel protection scheme is proposed and successfully demonstrated over field fiber links for 400G capacity using main 400G DP-16QAM and protection 400G DP-QPSK superchannels together with in-service OTDR fault localization.

articleTitle: Real-time evaluation of 26-GBaud PAM-4 intensity modulation and direct detection systems for data-center interconnects
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Real-time transmission with 26-GBaud PAM-4 as a promising modulation format for data-center interconnects with operation in C-band is evaluated. For an OSNR penalty below 2 dB a dispersion tolerance of up to 10 km of SSMF is achieved.

articleTitle: 25-Gb/s OOK and 4-PAM transmission over >35-km SSMF using directly modulated 1.5μm VCSEL
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We successfully transmit 25-Gb/s OOK and 4-PAM signals generated by using a directly-modulated 1.5-μm VCSEL (bandwidth: 7 GHz) over 45- and 35-km-long standard single-mode fibers, respectively, without neither optical amplifier nor optical dispersion compensation.

articleTitle: Low-chirp push-pull microring modulators
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate a new concept of low-chirp push-pull silicon microring modulator at 10 Gb/s. Differential drive of two microring modulators nested in a Mach-Zehnder interferometer balances the chirp from two ring modulators, resulting in very low chirp.

articleTitle: Experimental demonstration of phase-sensitive regeneration of a 10–20 Gb/s BPSK channel without a phase-locked loop using Brillouin amplification
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate all-optical phase-sensitive regeneration of a 10–20Gb/s BPSK signal without a phase-locked loop by amplifying the idler using Brillouin amplification. Phase noise reduction of up to 56% along with 11dB gain at BER of 10−5 were observed.

articleTitle: Analog transmission over few-mode fibers
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Few-mode fibers can increase optical power throughput, arguably the most important parameter that determines the RF gain, noise figure and dynamic range of long-distance analog fiber-optic links.

articleTitle: Polarization diverse fine resolution photonic spectral processor
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We extend the functionality of our photonic spectral processor to operate over any input polarization state by introducing polarization diversity. Some of the expected and unexpected challenges are discussed, leading to ~1GHz resolution programmable filtering.

articleTitle: Frequency-modulated continuous-wave LIDAR module in silicon photonics
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Frequency-modulated continuous-wave LIDAR is demonstrated with a silicon photonic device consisting of transmitting and receiving waveguides and photodetectors. A 20 mm resolution and 2 m range is shown. Simultaneous distance and velocity measurements are achieved.

articleTitle: 1Tb/s real-time 4×40Gbaud DP-16QAM superchannel using CFP2-ACO pluggables over 625 km of standard fibre
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: CFP2-ACO pluggables are used for the first real-time transmission of a lTb/s superchannel consisting of 4×40Gbaud 50GHz spaced DP-16QAM channels. Error free transmission is demonstrated over 6×104km of G.652 fibre with 92 neighbouring 100G channels.

articleTitle: A novel transmitter leveraging high-speed ultralow-power modulation of a Si microring modulator by eliminating tuning power
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose a novel transmitter having a Si microring modulator, and demonstrate a capability to eliminate most of ring tuning power, a dominant driver of energy consumption in microring-based transmitters, while preserving high-speed ultralow-power modulation.

articleTitle: Fault-tolerance enhanced design and analyses for optical pyramid data center network (OPMDC)
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: This paper presents a fault-tolerance enhanced design and analyses for OPMDC[1], Capacity-based analysis shows OPMDC accommodates 0.91-capacity under the worst-case single WSS-failure. Emulation analysis justifies that a 26dB-OSNR is retained under the worst-case three-WSS-failure scenario.

articleTitle: 60-km RoF transmission of four-polarization-multiplexed signals
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A scheme of four-polarization-multiplexed RoF signal transmission for quadrupling system capacity is proposed. Performance of 4×2-Gb/s data carried by 20-GHz RF signal over SMF link is evaluated with the maximum distance of 60-km.

articleTitle: Erbium-doped fiber: Amplifiers: What everyone needs to know
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: This paper discusses erbium-doped fiber amplifiers and its applications. EDFA gain performance and fiber optimization, EDFA saturation and output power, amplified spontaneous emission and noise, amplifier chains, gain spectra, broadband EDFAs and WDM systems, spectral and hole burning in EDFAs, EDFA gain dynamics and power transients, control, management and optical networks . distributed Raman amplifiers, applications of amplifiers in space division multiplexing were discussed.

articleTitle: Four-wave-mixing-free 12-Gbit/s MMWoF transmission with orthogonally polarized dual wavelength diode laser
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A four-wave-mixing-free MMWoF link with directly QAM-OFDM encoded dual-wavelength diode laser under orthogonal-polarized dual-mode injection-locking is demonstrated for fiber-wired 24-Gbit/s (in 25-km SMF) and remotely beat MMW 12-Gbit/s (in 1.6-m free space) transmissions.

articleTitle: Dynamic optical arbitrary waveform generation from a heterogeneously integrated InP/Si3N4 chip-scale module
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate static and dynamic optical arbitrary waveform generation in a heterogeneously integrated Si3N4 AWG-InP modulator array-Si3N4 AWG chip-scale module. High contrast Si3N4 AWGs and nearly pure phase InP modulation provided high fidelity OAWG.

articleTitle: Nonlinear optical properties of ytterbium-doped tantalum pentoxide rib waveguides on silicon at telecom wavelengths
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We report the linear and nonlinear characterization of low loss Yb:Ta<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>O<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">5</sub> rib waveguides fabricated by using CMOS compatible processes on a SOI substrate. We report a nonlinear refractive index of 6.65×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-18</sup> m<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>/W measured at telecom wavelengths.

articleTitle: Practical approaches to 400G single-carrier submarine transmission
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We review single-carrier 400 Gb/s transponder design and experiments. Requirements in terms of opto-electronic devices, modulation formats, error correction codes to push the transmission reach beyond transatlantic distances are described.

articleTitle: Th4B.1: Access-metro convergence in next generation broadband networks
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Summary of requirements: (1) An application-oriented approach to deliver better value. (2) Reliable applications (reliable capacity, latency, survivability,...). (3) Application availability anytime anywhere (really ubiquitous network access). (4) 5G requirements: data rate, latency, mobility, connections, energy and reliability. (5) Multiple technologies need to work seamlessly together. (6) Prepare for the unknown as most 5G applications are still unknown. (7) Improve network business case. (8) Reduction of network operating cost. (9) Lower capital cost for network equipment. (10) Sharing of cost of ownership. (11) Increase revenues by providing more and faster services. (12) Reduce energy consumption.

articleTitle: Experimental investigation of the validity domain of the Gaussian noise model over dispersion managed systems
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
