publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We designed and fabricated a fast-wavelength-tunable hybrid laser diode using two selectable silicon photonic Vernier ring-based cavities. Single mode operation (SMSR > 30 dB) over more than 35 nm and switching speed of 35 ns are demonstrated.

articleTitle: Zero-change CMOS photodiode with 0.44 A/W responsivity
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A photodiode with 0.44 A/W has been fabricated in the Global Foundries 45 nm 12SOI process - a twenty times increase over previous results. The photodiode consists of a ring-resonator with ring-shaped silicon-germanium.

articleTitle: All-fiber-based selective mode multiplexer and demultiplexer for six-mode multiplexed signals
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We experimentally evaluate performance of selective six-mode multiplexer based on mode selective couplers. The mode-group coupling is suppressed by -20dB, maintaining OSNR penalty of 3dB due to mode multiplexing even with use of 6×6 MIMO.

articleTitle: Photonic-assisted RF frontend operating at U-band and V-band based on Si3N4 ultra-high-Q bandpass filter
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A mutli-band photonic-assisted RF photonic frontend based on the high Q bandpass filter has been experimentally demonstrated at U- and V-band. The SFDR from 40 GHz to 65 GHz are larger than 95 dB-Hz<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2/3</sup>.

articleTitle: Silica-based highly nonlinear fiber advances
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Silica-based highly nonlinear fiber is utilized as platforms for various optical applications, taking advantage of its features including ultra-low loss, longitudinal uniformity, and controllability of dispersion characteristics as we herein discuss.

articleTitle: Receiver architecture with filter for power-efficient drop&waste networks
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Power budget analysis of filterless Drop and Waste networks is first reported. A receiver architecture encompassing a low-cost tunable integrated filter is then proposed and evaluated, showing significant improvements in power margin and optical reach.

articleTitle: Open database for interconnected traffic engineered multi-layer networks
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A database for interconnected TE networks is proposed and implemented to enable dedicated applications to perform complex multi-domain/layer operations. The database is successfully utilized for effective and highly-scalable maintenance applications in multi-layer networks.

articleTitle: Field trial of simultaneous 100-Gbps and 400-Gbps transmission using advanced digital coherent technologies
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We achieve double the performance in 400-Gbps optical transmission employing advanced digital coherent technologies based on field trials. Additionally, we show stable transmission of 400-Gbps channels that does not affect the existing 100-Gbps channels.

articleTitle: 125-μm-Cladding coupled multi-core fiber with ultra-low loss of 0.158 dB/km and record-low spatial mode dispersion of 6.1 ps/km
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A 125-μm-cladding coupled four-core fiber realized 0.158-dB/km attenuation at 1550 nm and 6.1-ps/km12 spatial mode dispersion over C-band, both of which are the lowest ever reported among optical fibers for the space-division multiplexed transmission.

articleTitle: 31-GHz single-carrier, 44.6-Gbps photonic wireless transmission using a wide-bandwidth high power photodetector and a pre-distortion technique
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Single-carrier photonic wireless transmission at 31 GHz and 8.0 Gbaud with 64QAM is successfully achieved with error-free operation. A newly developed wide bandwidth high power photodetector and a pre-equalizing subsystem are presented.

articleTitle: Demonstration of an ultra-compact photonic integrated orbital angular momentum emitter with a Bragg grating silicon microring
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: An orbital angular momentum beam emitter for wireless optical interconnects consisting of a Bragg grating integrated in a silicon 3.9pm-radius microring is experimentally demonstrated achieving a 3dB-bandwidth of 134 GHz and an efficiency up to 6.5%.

articleTitle: How pessimistic is a worst-case SNR degradation as a link abstraction metric?
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We consider a fully loaded, worst-case SNR degradation as an abstraction metric for impairment aware link virtualization. For the NSF topology with minimal fully connected load, the power optimized SNR is only 0.6 dB better.

articleTitle: 7.5 Gb/s direct DFB phase modulation with 8-DPSK for 6.25 GHz spaced coherent UDWDM-PONs
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate an 8-DPSK directly phase-modulated DFB with intradyne detection in a 50 km, 6.25 GHz channel spaced UDWDM-PON. A bit rate of 7.5 Gb/s is achieved with Rx sensitivity of -31 dBm at BER=10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-3</sup>.

articleTitle: Experimental evaluation of the crosstalk impacts of cascaded ROADMs supporting space division multiplexing
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We experimentally evaluated the crosstalk impacts of cascaded ROADMs for SDM networks. Crosstalk induced Q penalties in 128 Gb/s transmission were compared for interleaved and grouped configurations, with 1-1.5 dB improvement for the interleaved setup.

articleTitle: 34.6 Tb/s (173×256Gb/s) single-band transmission over 2400km fiber using complementary Raman/EDFA
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We experimentally demonstrated 70nm seamless band transmission of 173×256Gb/s PM-16QAM signals over 2400km of TeraWave™ fiber. The complementary Raman/EDFAs were used to achieve the 34.6Tb/s capacity wide single-band transmission with terrestrial fiber span length.

articleTitle: Experimental comparison of artificial neural network and volterra based nonlinear equalization for CO-OFDM
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A novel artificial neural network (ANN)-based nonlinear equalizer (NLE) of low complexity is demonstrated for 40-Gb/s CO-OFDM at 2000 km, revealing ~1.5 dB enhancement in Q-factor compared to inverse Volterra-series transfer function based NLE.

articleTitle: High port count hybrid wavelength switched TDMA (WS-TDMA) optical switch for data centers
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A WS-TDMA optical switch fabric scalable to 1024 ports is demonstrated. Fast tunable (<200ns) transceivers using bipolar encoded transmission and coherent reception enable wavelength switching and TDMA over a passive star network for low latency packet level switching.

articleTitle: 420Gbit/s DP-64QAM Nyquist-FDM single-carrier system
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose two enabling technologies for single-carrier Nyquist frequency division multiplexing transceiver, pilot based carrier phase recovery and I/Q modulator bias drift compensation. 420Gbit/s net capacity is demonstrated and the maximum unrepeated reach is 160km.

articleTitle: Black link versus cutting edge transceivers: A comparison for next generation WDM optical networks
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We compare WDM optical networks employing Black Link interfaces versus proprietary-based transceivers. Future optimal use and coexistence of both approaches is analyzed using latest conceptual and experimental achievements at 400G and beyond.

articleTitle: Link performance investigation of industry first 100G PAM4 IC chipset with real-time DSP for data center connectivity
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate, for the first time by employing newly developed PAM4 chipset and direct detection with commercial 25Gbaud devices, the link operates error free under KR4 FEC threshold at 1310nm wavelength(s) for 100Gb/s up to 40km distance of standard single mode fiber.

articleTitle: 56-Gbit/s 4-D PAM-4 TCM transmission evaluation for 400-G data center applications
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate 56-Gbit/s 4-D PAM-4 TCM transmission over 40 km SMF without optical amplifiers. Results show that TCM PAM-4 outperforms the uncoded PAM-4 by more than 2.5 dB at a BER equal to 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-6</sup>.

articleTitle: Monolithic silicon photonics at 25 Gb/s
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Monolithic CMOS photonics seeks to minimize total transceiver cost by simplifying packaging, design and test. Here we examine 25 Gb/s applications in the context of integrated transistor performance and demonstrate a 4λ×25 Gb/s reference design.

articleTitle: Survivable multipath routing and resource assignment with SRLG in virtual optical networks
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose a survivable routing and resource assignment scheme with MPP and SRLG in VON to get less resources consumption and enough protection against physical failure. 29% reduction in resource consumption can be achieved.

articleTitle: 2R regeneration of 12 WDM channels with 100-GHz spacing in a group-delay-managed nonlinear medium
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate simultaneous regeneration of 12×10 Gb/s WDM channels in a group-delay-managed Mamyshev 2R regenerator. For signals degraded by broadband noise, eye opening improvements of 3 dB or higher are observed for all 12 channels.

articleTitle: On the impact of deploying federated SDN controllers in optical transport networks
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: This paper proposes a federated SDN controller architecture for optical networks. Simulations show that adequate combination of clustering strategies with enriched hierarchical path computation offer a routing performance comparable to conventional centralized architectures.

articleTitle: PDM DDO-OFDM with self-polarization diversity for the backhaul of radio-over-fiber system
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A self-polarization diversity mechanism in a polarization division multiplexing direct detection optical OFDM radio-over-fiber system's backhaul is proposed and demonstrated to double the channel capacity and service coverage without polarization tracking mechanism and receiver modification.

articleTitle: Bandwidth enhancement in multimode polymer waveguides using waveguide layout for optical printed circuit boards
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Dispersion studies demonstrate that waveguide layout can be used to enhance the bandwidth performance of multimode polymer waveguides for use in board-level optical interconnects, providing >40 GHz×m without the need for any launch conditioning.

articleTitle: Wavelength and pump power characterization of low-phase-noise Kerr frequency comb lines
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We characterize a low-phase-noise Kerr frequency comb for carrying data channels. Results show pump wavelength detuning region grows slightly at higher pump power and the phase noise stays relatively unchanged over pump wavelength detuning region.

articleTitle: On-chip tunable microwave photonic filters with a reconfigurable bandwidth of up to 440 MHz
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Microwave photonic filters tunable up to 30 GHz are realized on a chip using stimulated Brillouin scattering. Tailoring of the pump allows bandwidth reconfigurability from 50MHz to 440MHz with a pass band ripple of <;2dB.

articleTitle: Rethinking and redesigning the semiconductor laser/quantum noise controlled semiconductor lasers
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: The present canonical design of the semiconductor laser (SCL), in force since The early 1970s, is incompatible with high coherence (narrow linewidth). The reason is fundamental and is a consequence of the quantum-mandated umbilical relationship between induced emission (gain) and spontaneous emission (noise) exacerbated by the modal concentration of optical energy in the high loss III-V material. We demonstrate, theoretically and experimentally, a new design paradigm which results in over three orders of magnitude reduction in the spectral linewidth of the SCL compared to commercial lasers now deployed. The key difference is a radical (some 99% in our case) transfer of stored optical energy from the III-V material to nearly transparent silicon which is an integral part of the laser resonator. This laser should constitute a serious candidate to take over the role of the Distributed Feedback (DFB) SCL as the light source for future coherent optical networks.

articleTitle: Inter-channel nonlinear interference noise in fully loaded WDM systems
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We explore the properties of inter-channel nonlinear interference noise in fully loaded WDM systems. We assess the significance of nonlinear phase and polarization-rotation noise and discuss its importance in the evaluation of system performance.

articleTitle: Experimental demonstration of optical wireless personal area communication system supporting multiple users
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: An optical wireless personal area communication system is experimentally demonstrated based on 16-CAP modulation combined with TDM for multi-user function. 4 Gb/s data transmission with an average BER<; 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-4</sup> for up to 10 users can be achieved at 2 m distance.

articleTitle: Towards energy-efficient CMOS-backend compatible photonic circuits
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We present energy-efficient optical add/drop multiplexers based on low-loss a-Si:H. The power for non-uniformity compensation is studied and the reduction by trimming is analyzed, resulting in record low metrics of sub-1mW consumption per 8-channel multiplexer.

articleTitle: 32QAM photonic vector signal generation utilizing a single-drive intensity MZM without pre-coding technique
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: 32QAM and 16QAM photonic vector signals generation at 37 GHz are experimentally demonstrated based on optical carrier suppression employing only one single-drive intensity modulator, with the BER under 7% pre-FEC threshold of 3.8×10-3.

articleTitle: Functional service design with SDN orchestration across heterogeneous multi-domain networks
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A “service design” paradigm is presented to flexibly accommodate customized services by applying and chaining reconfigurable virtual network functions. Functional and featured service provisioning is demonstrated across heterogeneous IP/OPS/OCS domain networks with end-to-end SDN orchestration.

articleTitle: Optical and environmental performance of an epoxy-less, metallic, single-mode SC-UPC ferrolder® based connector
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: This paper presents optical and environmental test results on SC-UPC pigtails terminated with Ferrolder® and zirconia ferrules. The Ferrolder, a ferrule and holder in one solution, is an epoxy-less replacement for ceramic ferrule and holder.

articleTitle: Antiresonant hollow core fiber with octave spanning bandwidth for short haul data communications
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We report an effectively singlemode tubular antiresonant hollow core fiber with >1000nm bandwidth and record-low loss of 25dB/km, fully connectorizable with SMF28. We demonstrate penalty-free data transmission at wavelengths of 1065, 1565 and 1963nm.

articleTitle: Experimental demonstration of chip-scale orbital angular momentum (OAM) beams generation and detection using nanophotonic dielectric metasurface array
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We design and experimentally investigate the generation of orbital angular momentum (OAM) beams with topological number from l = -4 to 4 at the wavelength of 632.8 nm utilizing the nanophotonic dielectric metasurface array. We also detect the generated OAM beams using the dielectric metasurface array corresponding to their inverted topological number.

articleTitle: Demonstration of SDN enabled dynamically reconfigurable high capacity optical access for converged services
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A dynamically reconfigurable TDM-DWDM PON for converged multi-services at the physical layer (10G, 100G and wireless fronthaul) has been demonstrated for the first time implementing end-to-end SDN management of the access and core network elements.

articleTitle: Experimental demonstration of bidirectional MDM-WDM-TDM-PON over low modal-crosstalk FMF
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose a bidirectional MDM-WDM-TDM-PON architecture, in which mode is induced as independent multiplexing granularity and smooth evolution from conventional WDM-TDM-PON is achieved. Bidirectional transmission over 10-km 2-mode FMF and 10-km SSMF is experimental demonstrated.

articleTitle: Optimization of large area, low loss fiber designs for C+L band transmission
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We will discuss design principles and properties of large effective area, low loss fibers for C+L band transmission. These fibers need to have excellent cabling properties from 1530 to 1610nm.

articleTitle: A novel lens design for 10Gbps/25Gbps high speed optical interconnects
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A novel FOCI lens system was designed in our AOC optical engines for data transmissions at 10Gbps and 25Gbps. This design can be applied to AOC types such as USB3.0, 10G SFP+AOC and 40G QSFP+AOC.

articleTitle: Demonstration of non-intrusive in-band OSNR measurement technique for PM-16QAM signals with spectral shaping and subject to fiber nonlinearity
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A non-intrusive in-band OSNR measurement method is experimentally investigated on polarization-multiplexed signals, including spectrally-shaped PM-16QAM, at OSNR levels beyond 25dB and under strong nonlinear conditions. OSNR measurement statistics demonstrate sufficient accuracy for practical network applications.

articleTitle: A simplified adaptive modulation scheme for RSOA based DDO-OFDM system using CAZAC precoding
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We experimentally demonstrated a RSOA based DDO-OFDM system using CAZAC precoding. Adaptive modulation has been simply and efficiently performed after CAZAC precoding to improve the sensitivity and overall data rate thanks to the equalized SNR.

articleTitle: Full-mesh optical backplane with modular fiber ribbon-based sub-circuits
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A modular, scalable and full-mesh bandwidth-upgradable optical interconnection between optoelectronic boards is guaranteed thanks to an optimized layout of standard MM fiber ribbons which divides the overall backplane into independent optical sub-circuits.

articleTitle: Experimental study of symbol-rates and MQAM formats for single carrier 400 Gb/s and few carrier 1 Tb/s options
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Based on state-of-the-art transmitter technology we investigated symbol-rate (up to 64Gbd) and constellation size (up to 64QAM) dependencies on the linear and nonlinear transmission performance and compare the maximum SMF reach of various single carrier 400 Gb/s and few carriers 1 Tb/s options.

articleTitle: Multi-dimension coded PAM4 signaling for 100Gb/s short-reach transceivers
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We report on the use of 4-Dimension coded modulation for short-reach interfaces. With low extra complexity, 4D-coded PAM4 enables a performance improvement when associated with low-latency and low-complexity FEC, as demonstrated by experimental results.

articleTitle: Depletion-based optical modulators in a bulk 65 nm CMOS platform
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We present poly-silicon depletion-based optical modulators realized in a 65 nm CMOS platform for monolithic integration with electronics. Speeds up to 12.5 Gbit/s can be achieved with 5 dB insertion loss and 2.3 dB extinction ratio.

articleTitle: Open and programmable metro networks
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: To achieve network-wide programmability and observability, open source and vendor-agnostic interfaces are critical. We discuss the re-design of the metro network, demonstrate practical and scalable operational models, and introduce a disaggregated ROADM architecture.

articleTitle: Side-view based angle alignment technique for multi-core fiber
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Precise rotational angle alignment to splice multi-core fiber is successfully achieved by analyzing the symmetricity of side view contrast. Our proposed technique potentially enables the automatic passive low loss fusion splicing of multi-core fiber.

articleTitle: 224-Gbps transmission for next-generation WDM long-reach PON using CAP modulation
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Leveraging high transmission bandwidth and loss budget provided by high launch power, we experimentally demonstrate 4-λ 224-Gbps 32-CAP 60-km transmission using cost-effective 10-GHz-class EAM/PIN, supporting >3-Gbps/ONU for a 64-ONU LR-PON, without inline and pre-amplifier.

articleTitle: Hitless dynamic wavelength allocation in coherent WDM-PONs
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We introduce a novel algorithm for real-time ONU activation (λ - assignment) and reconfiguration (λ - tuning) in WDM coherent PONs. The algorithm prevents service interruption of lighted channels and it is experimentally demonstrated by using real-time fully-analog coherent transceivers.

articleTitle: Simplified DSP-based signal-signal beat interference mitigation for direct-detection subcarrier modulation
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We proposed a novel SSBI mitigation technique with significantly lower DSP complexity. It was experimentally tested in 7×25 Gb/s WDM DD SSB 16-QAM N-SCM signal transmission over 480 km SSMF with a net ISD of 2.4 (b/s)/Hz.

articleTitle: Clock extraction for 28 Gb/s OOK receivers in band-limited dispersive optical channels
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We investigate timing recovery schemes for 28 Gb/s NRZ-OOK systems employing inexpensive 1550 nm 7-GHz TOSA and ROSA devices in DCF-free links up to 100 km and propose a low-complexity algorithm enabling reliable clock extraction.

articleTitle: The PON roadmap
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: With the recent conclusion of the NG-PON2 standards in the ITU-T, the fiber access industry is now considering where to go next. This paper reviews some of the options for the evolution of passive optical networks.

articleTitle: High-power waveguide integrated modified uni-traveling-carrier (UTC) photodiode with 5 dBm RF output power at 120 GHz
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrated a monolithic InP-based high-power high-speed waveguide integrated modified UTC photodetector. The chip delivers maximum RF output power levels of 8.9dBm to 5.1dBm in the frequency range between 60GHz and 120GHz.

articleTitle: 10.7 Gb/s WDM transmission over 100-m SI-POF with discrete multitone
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We report the record capacity of 10.7 Gb/s over 100-m step-index polymer optical fiber (SI-POF) with 1-mm core diameter over six WDM channels in visible wavelength range.

articleTitle: Polarisation insensitive coherent receiver PIC for 100Gbaud communication
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate an InP-based receiver photonic integrated circuit (PIC) with a 90° hybrid and balanced pin-photodiodes (PD). The detector chip has an excellent responsivity, an electrical bandwidth of 90GHz and a phase error below 5° for TE and TM over the entire C-band.

articleTitle: A practicable rate-adaptive FEC scheme flexible about capacity and distance in optical transport networks
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose a practicable rate-adaptive FEC scheme defeating degradation due to high baud rate and increase of circuit complexity. The preferable coding gains of 13.0-17.5 dB are obtained for 25.5-149.5% redundancies.

articleTitle: Optical interconnect with densely integrated plasmonic modulator and germanium photodetector arrays
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate the first chip-to-chip interconnect utilizing a densely integrated plasmonic Mach-Zehnder modulator array operating at 3 × 10 Gbit/s. A multicore fiber provides a compact optical interface, while the receiver consists of germanium photodetectors.

articleTitle: Mm-wave vector signal generation and transport for W-band MIMO system with intensity modulation and direct detection
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate mm-wave vector signal generation and transport for W-band MIMO system with intensity-modulation and direct-direction for the first time. Compared to previous schemes, we largely simplify this MIMO system.

articleTitle: Design of low-margin optical networks
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We review margins used in optical networks and show how they can be reduced through proper design to increase network capacity; flexible optoelectronic nodes coupled with optical monitoring are key to fully leverage network margins.

articleTitle: On spectral phase estimation of noisy solitonic transmission
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We consider the coherent transmission of soliton pulses over a long noisy optical link. We propose an efficient estimation of the transmitted nonlinear spectral phase based on Minimum Mean Square Error estimation of the eigenvalues trajectory.

articleTitle: Experimental demonstration of PDM-32QAM single-carrier 400G over 1200-km transmission enabled by training-assisted pre-equalization and look-up table
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate a single-carrier 400G solution based on 51.25-GBaud PDM-32QAM signal at 6.15-b/s/Hz SE over 1200-km transmission distance. Training assisted pre-compensations and both transmitter and receiver based look-up table are employed to mitigate channel bandwidth constraint and component nonlinearity impairment.

articleTitle: Single lane 112-Gbps analog small form-factor pluggable module with only 4-GHz end-to-end 3-dB bandwidth employing duobinary 4-PAM
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We report a novel single-lane 112-Gbps system based on SFP module with 10km SSMF reach employing a duobinary 4-PAM modulation. Impairment caused by electrical circuit is compensated by digital pre-distortion techniques.

articleTitle: Low-loss and Low-DMD few-mode multi-core fiber with highest core multiplicity factor
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate 246 μm cladding 6-mode 19-core fiber and realize twice the spatial density of other multi-core fiber with more than 100 channels, while achieving the lowest loss and differential mode delay of 0.33 ns/km.

articleTitle: Coherent access
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: The combination of digital signal processing, Nyquist pulse shaping, single side band modulation and coherent detection are addressed as key enablers for future optical access networks. These techniques guarantee seamless coexistence with other legacy technologies.

articleTitle: An accurate nonlinear noise insensitive OSNR monitor
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose a new design for pilot based OSNR monitor with XPM noise exclusion at the receiver side. High accuracy and low nonlinear sensitivity (<0.5dB error) are proved by 1Tb/s superchannel transmission experiments.

articleTitle: Correlations and phase noise in NLIN-modelling and system implications
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We present a method for the accurate prediction of BER in nonlinear systems, taking into account the temporal correlations of the nonlinear interference noise and incorporating the effect of an adaptive receiver.

articleTitle: Passive athermal silicon ring resonators with sol-gel claddings
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Silicon ring resonators have high thermal sensitivity of about 0.1 nm/°C. Using sol-gels as cladding material we show that sensitivity can be reduced down to 2 pm/°C within the temperature range from 12 °C to 40 °C.

articleTitle: Experimental performance evaluation of analog signal transmission system with photonic integrated optical vortex emitter and 3.6 km few-mode fiber link
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate and evaluate the performance of analog signal transmission system with photonic integrated optical vortex emitter and 3.6 km few-mode fiber (FMF) link using OAM2 and OAM-2 modes and measured the spurious free dynamic range (SFDR) of the second-order harmonic distortion (SHD).

articleTitle: O-band silicon photonic Bragg-grating multiplexers using UV lithography
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate the first Bragg-grating-based 4-channel O-band (de-)multiplexer fabricated using 193nm lithography on submicron-SOI with small features below 140nm.

articleTitle: Broadband light bending with a doublet silicon nanopost array
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A subwavelength silicon nanoposts array featuring high bending efficiencies in the wavelength of 1480-1600 nm are demonstrated. The compactness, low loss, and CMOS compatibility enable the structure a promising component for on-chip optical control.

articleTitle: Controllable group delay in a θ-shaped microfiber resonator with coupled-resonator-induced transparency
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: The control of Light velocity is theoretically and experimentally demonstrated in a θ-shaped microfiber resonator with coupled-resonator-induced transparency. By adjusting the structure parameters, group delays from -60ps to 200ps are achieved in the all-fiber resonator.

articleTitle: First demonstration of cognitive SDN orchestration: A real-time congestion-aware services provisioning over OFDM-based 400G OPS and Flexi-WDM OCS networks
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Cognitive SDN orchestration over 400-Gbps OPS and Tbps-class Flexi-WDM networks is demonstrated, where the SDN-controllable OFDM transponders and the extended transport API enable the congestion-aware provisioning of end-to-end real-time services.

articleTitle: Mode filter based on graphene-embedded waveguide
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose a graphene-embedded waveguide structure for spatial-mode-filtering applications. Our experimental demonstration with a graphene film placed in a polymer two-mode waveguide core achieves a mode extinction ratio over 20dB against the fundamental TE mode.

articleTitle: A bend-insensitive ultra low loss and large Aeff fibre for long haul transmission
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A large effective area fiber (110μm2)with excellent bend-insensitive characteristics and attenuation lower than 0.160dB/km is presented. It's excellent bend-insensitive performance is benefit for cable temperature cycling test and attenuation change during cabling process.

articleTitle: Bidirectional coherent PON with ONU based on reused direct-modulated LO
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate a bidirectional coherent PON based on a direct-modulated upstream signal reused as LO. The proposed system achieves −46/−48 dBm downstream/upstream sensitivity at BER=10−3.

articleTitle: Novel integration technologies for disruptive capacity upgrade in data center systems
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Recent data-center targeted photonic components based on HHI's PolyBoard platform are reviewed. Hybrid-integrated transmitters and receivers, as well as a 3-D photonic integration, show the PolyBoard capability for 1Tb/s data-center connectivity.

articleTitle: A jitter-reduction packaging structure for a 56-Gb/s NRZ modulated optical receiver
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A 56-Gb/s optical receiver, consisting of a PD and a SiGe BiCMOS TIA flip-chip mounted on a ceramic package, was developed. It achieves error-free operation (at 56 Gb/s) with jitter margin of 0.38 UI.

articleTitle: On-chip transmitter and receiver front-ends for ultra-broadband wired and optical-fiber communications
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Increasing line rates beyond 56Gb/s is a big challenge for transceiver front-ends. We discuss recent developments towards 100Gb/s copper, +56Gb/s multi-channel single-mode VCSEL links and segmented MZM drivers for advanced modulation.

articleTitle: A flexible, ethernet fronthaul for 5th generation mobile and beyond
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Using Ethernet in the fronthaul can deliver the statistical multiplexing gains offered by the new functional splits proposed for the radio access network, but latency and delay variations are challenges that must be overcome.

articleTitle: Demonstration of OAM-based MIMO FSO link using spatial diversity and MIMO equalization for turbulence mitigation
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate and investigate the performance of a multi-input-multiple-output (MIMO) free-space optical link employing orbital-angular-momentum multiplexing through turbulent channel. We show that turbulence effects can be mitigated by exploiting spatial diversity and MIMO equalization.

articleTitle: 50Gb/s silicon photonics platform for short-reach optical interconnects
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We review a silicon photonics platform that integrates low-loss passive components with high-speed modulators and photodetectors operating at 50Gb/s from CMOS compatible voltages.

articleTitle: Intrinsic robustness of fiber misaligned connections and reflection noise in plastic optical fiber links for cost-effective radio-over-fiber systems
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We evaluate and compare radio-over-fiber transmission performances in terms of fiber misaligned connection and reflection noise in silica multimode fibers and plastic optical fibers (POFs). The results show that POFs have much higher transmission performances.

articleTitle: Multi-port optical switch based on silicon photonics
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We review research progress on multiport optical switches based on silicon photonics, with a primary focus on our own 8×8, 32×32 PILOSS switches, polarization insensitivity and integration with electronics. Challenges and future prospects are discussed.

articleTitle: Integrated ultra-low-loss silicon nitride waveguide coil for optical gyroscopes
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate, for the first time, a Sagnac sensor using an on-chip 3m ultra-low-loss silicon nitride waveguide coil.

articleTitle: System validation of polymer-based transmitter optical sub-assembly for 100G/200G modules
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: This paper experimentally demonstrates Polymer-based transmitter optical sub-assembly (TOSA) for CFP2-ACO modules running at 100G/200G Flexigrid WDM (37.5 GHz). Compared to LiNbO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>, the ultra-compact TOSA provides excellent performance both in back-to-back and over long-haul distances.

articleTitle: 105.1 Tb/s power-efficient transmission over 14,350 km using a 12-core fiber
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate the use of MCF for power efficient ultra-high capacity long haul transmission. Feasibility of 105.1 Tb/s transmission over 14,350 km is shown using 12-core fiber and power equivalent of a single pump laser.

articleTitle: PAM-4 and Duobinary direct modulation of a hybrid InP/SOI DFB laser for 40 Gb/s transmission over 2 km single mode fiber
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate 40 Gb/s PAM-4 and Duobinary direct modulation of a heterogeneously integrated InP on SOI DFB laser. Transmission measurement was performed using a 2 km NZ-DSF with a PRBS 215 and 1.5 Vpp swing voltage.

articleTitle: Optical sensing of electrical fields in harsh environments
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: This paper shows a method allowing electric field sensing in high vibration environments. The vibration sensitivity is reduced using a push-pull configuration and external phase modulation. This paper provides both theoretical description and experimental verification.

articleTitle: Scalable photonic packet switch test-bed for datacenters
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate scaling photonic switch for a datacenter using arrays of fast silicon photonic space switches that are time-slot synchronized, despite the varying distance of interconnected nodes. A low latency scheduling algorithm allows high throughput, with latency comparable to electronic switches.

articleTitle: Enabling mobility in LED based two nodes VLC network employing self-adaptive STBC
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We experimentally demonstrates a VLC downlink based on two LEDs and one mobile user. A self-adaptive STBC is proposed in this work to suppress the interference between VLC nodes, resulting in a significant mobile feasibility.

articleTitle: Compact silicon photonic interleaver using loop-mirror-based Michelson-Gires-Tournois interferometer
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A compact (125 μm × 376 μm) silicon photonic interleaver is proposed and experimentally demonstrated using loop-mirror-based Michelson-Gires-Tournois interferometer. The 3-dB and 20-dB bandwidths of the passband are ~1.245 nm and ~1.709 nm, respectively.

articleTitle: Towards a control plane management architecture enabling proactive network predictability
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: This work demonstrates, for the first time, an algorithm capable of predicting network configurations based on traffic monitoring and user configuration inputs. We evaluate node flexibility and entropy to get more meaningful results.

articleTitle: Ultra-wideband radar for breath tracking with optical fiber for remote reach extension
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We report on the experimental demonstration of an UWB radar with fiber extension for remote breath tracking through 10 cm of concrete. The radar is based on telecom class equipment.

articleTitle: 200m 2×50 Gb/s PAM-4 SWDM transmission over wideband multimode fiber using VCSELs and pre-distortion signaling
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We present successful PAM-4 transmissions at 50 Gb/s over 200 m of novel wideband multimode fiber using VCSELs at 850 and 980 nm with linear and non-linear pre-distortion input signal.

articleTitle: Multipoint platform for control and routing of complex silicon photonic circuits with non-invasive probes
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: An-all-in-one digital electronic platform to exploit multiple non-invasive light power probes (CLIPP) in silicon photonic waveguides is presented, featuring a 32-channel CMOS ASIC end and 16 heater drivers for real-time monitoring, reconfiguring and light-path tracking.

articleTitle: Broadband bidirectional vertical grating coupler
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We have designed and fabricated a bidirectional vertical grating coupler, with a simulated coupling efficiency of -2.1dB and 3-dB bandwidth of 112nm, and a measured coupling efficiency of -3.9dB and 3-dB bandwidth of 104nm.

articleTitle: Using carrier level performance data to predict network outages, trending, & fiber health
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We can demonstrate how large pools of performance data are used to prevent customer affecting events and verify initial as-built amplifier designs will last through to end-of-life. The primary focus is to eliminate the slow moving train wreck, but a side benefit is a second source of data to predict network hot spots and growth trends.

articleTitle: Broadband fiber optical parametric amplifier formed by two pairs of four-wave mixing in a tellurite microstructured optical fiber
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A tellurite microstructured fiber-based optical parametric amplification has been achieved by utilizing two pairs of four-wave mixing. A high peak gain of ~102 dB can be obtained in a broadband from 1424 to 1459 nm.

articleTitle: A gain-integrated silicon photonic carrier with SOA-array for scalable optical switch fabrics
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We built a 4-channel photonic carrier with input/output SiN waveguides and a flip-chip-attached SOA array, incorporating end-to-end reflection-management and mode-matching. All channels demonstrate fiber-to-fiber gain of >10dB and support error-free 4-λ × 25-Gb/s WDM links.

articleTitle: All-fiber mode multiplexers
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We discuss the development of all-fiber photonic lantern mode multiplexers for space division multiplexing. Fiber mode multiplexers offer great potential for high capacity transmission systems thanks to their low-loss, broad bandwidth and superb mode scalability.

articleTitle: Single chip 52 Gb/s PAM4 transmission through −58 and +10 ps/nm chromatic dispersion using directly modulated laser
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We present successful transmission of 52Gb/s PAM4 through -58 and +10 ps/nm of SMF using a single chip and directly modulated laser. The receiver sensitivities are compared using APD and PIN PD at the receiver.

articleTitle: Multiband OQAM CAP modulation in MMW RoF systems with enhanced spectral and computational efficiency
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate an OQAM CAP modulation technique for high-capacity small-cell RoF systems with IOTA pulse shaping. Comparing with traditional CAP modulation, both spectral and computational efficiencies are improved with 50% less number of filter taps.

articleTitle: Experimental demonstration of sub-Nyquist sampling for bandwidth- and hardware-efficient mobile fronthaul supporting 128×128 MIMO with 100-MHz OFDM signals
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose and demonstrate a novel sub-Nyquist sampling technique for bandwidth-efficient and hardware-efficient mobile fronthaul supporting massive MIMO, simultaneously achieving 32-fold reduction in sampling rate and 1.5-dB improvement in performance in a 128×128 MIMO experiment.

articleTitle: 40-Gb/s TDM-PON downstream with low-cost EML transmitter and 3-level detection APD receiver
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We report a cost-effective 40-Gb/s TDM-PON downstream utilizing an integrated DFB-EAM in OLT and an APD-based 3-level detection receiver in ONU, achieving a high power budget of 23.4 dB in real time operation.

articleTitle: Phase pre-distortion for non-orthogonal multiple access in visible light communications
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose a phase pre-distortion method to improve the symbol-error-rate performance of non-orthogonal multiple access in visible light communications. Both theoretical analysis and experimental evaluation have been performed to prove its effectiveness.

articleTitle: First experimental demonstration of nonlinear inverse synthesis transmission over transoceanic distances
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate for the first time, the transmission performance of 10Gbaud nonlinear inverse synthesis based signal over transoceanic distances, showing a significant improvement in data capacity × distance product (x12) compared with other NFT-based systems.

articleTitle: Demonstration of a real-time 25-Gb/s TDM-PON system with 25-Gb/s downstream based on optical duobinary and 10-Gb/s burst-mode upstream based on NRZ
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate a real-time 25-Gb/s TDM-PON prototype system with 25-Gb/s optical duobinary for downstream and 10-Gb/s burst-mode NRZ for upstream, achieving 34.5-dB loss budget, 20-km SSMF reach with 1:512 splitting, and multi-user MAC layer processing.

articleTitle: Real-time Bi-directional 10GbE transmission using MIMO-less space-division-multiplexing with spatial modes
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Bi-directional transmission using MIMO-less space-division-multiplexing with spatial modes is experimentally demonstrated. 10GbE real-time data-streams are bi-directionally transmitted error-free (<;-22.0dB mode crosstalk) using LP01↔LP11° and LP11°↔LP11e modes over a 0.5km, elliptical-core, few-mode optical fiber full-duplex.

articleTitle: Relationship between mode-crosstalk and fiber characteristics in few mode fibers
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We review our recent experimental research work on mode-crosstalk in a transmission line composed of few mode fibers. We discuss the mode crosstalk at a splice point and in a fiber.

articleTitle: In-line optical amplification for Si waveguides on 1×8 splitter and selector by flip-chip bonded InP-SOAs
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We investigated hybrid-integration of InP semiconductor optical amplifier on silicon photonics chip using flip-chip bonding, and achieved in-line optical amplification of 10 dB. Silicon 1×8 splitter and selector are fabricated and operated with on-chip loss-compensation.

articleTitle: 10 Spatial mode transmission over 40km 50μm core diameter multimode fiber
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: 10 spatial mode transmission over 40km multi-mode fiber (50μm core diameter) with low DMGD is demonstrated using low-loss all-fiber 10-port photonic lanterns and 20×20 multiple-input multiple-output time-domain equalizer. A maximum MDL of 4.5dB is observed.

articleTitle: Strongly-coupled two-LP-mode ring-core fiber with optimized index profile considering S-bend model
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: The mode coupling efficiency of ring-core fiber can be increased by optimizing the fiber structure parameter considering an S-bend model. The coupling coefficient is successfully controlled using ring-core fiber fabricated with Aeff of 290 μm2.

articleTitle: Using advanced S2 analysis to measure mode coupling in a 2-LP-mode fiber
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Mode coupling in a step-index 2-LP-mode fiber has been experimentally studied using advanced S2 analysis. A wire-mesh is used to locally induce micro-bending and it is demonstrated that coupling coefficients can be extracted.

articleTitle: Distributed vibration sensing with high frequency response based on frequency division multiplexing
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A scheme combining phase-sensitive optical time domain reflectometry and Mach-Zehnder interferometer based on frequency division multiplexing has been demonstrated. The spatial resolution of 10m over 3Km sensing fiber and vibration frequency of 40 KHz are obtained.

articleTitle: Novel concepts and recent progress in distributed optical fiber sensing
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Recent techniques open new perspectives for distributed fiber sensing. Pulse coding and multi-dimensional denoising methods result in a > 10 dB noise reduction with minor modifications of the experimental layout.

articleTitle: Frequency nondegenerate optical parametric phase-sensitive amplifier repeater by using recovered pump carrier generated from phase-conjugated twin waves
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: ND-PSA repeaters using recovered pump generated from PCTWs is proposed. Calculations show proposed repeaters enables over 76-span transmission of 20-Gbit/s QPSK PCTWs, and phase-synchronization using sum frequency light from BPSK PCTWs is experimentally demonstrated.

articleTitle: Full stabilization of an electro-optic comb to a mode-locked fiber comb
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate full phase locking of an electro-optic comb to a fiber comb. Both the cw seed laser for the EO comb and the applied RF modulation frequency are referenced to comb lines within the fiber comb spectrum.

articleTitle: Highly spectral efficient elastic optical network employing grouped optical path routing
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We proposed a novel elastic optical network architecture employing Grouped Routing that enhances frequency utilization. With a developed network design algorithm, necessary fiber number was further reduced +20% compared with conventional elastic optical path network.

articleTitle: High-accuracy gain-isolated volterra nonlinear behavior model for wideband driver in optical coherent transmitter
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Gain-isolated Volterra nonlinear model is proposed for the electrical driver. Experiment demonstrates 0.5dB Q error when input signal is PAM 2/4/8 corresponding to 4/16/64QAM modulation. Furthermore, nonlinear impact of driver and Mach-Zehnder modulator are simulated.

articleTitle: Requirements and results for practical VCSEL transmission using PAM-4 over MMF
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: This paper discusses the evolution of VCSEL links. Impairments and noise (RIN, MPN) of MMF links were studied using simulation and modeling tools. PAM-4 transmission results in OM4 and wideband fiber are presented.

articleTitle: Availability-aware service provisioning in EONs: How efficient will FIPP-p-cycles be?
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose to realize availability-aware service provisioning in EONs with FIPP-p-cycles and bandwidth-squeezed restoration. Simulation results show that the proposed schemes are more reliable and spectrum-efficient than the existing approach.

articleTitle: Wavelength demultiplexer operating over mode division multiplexed signals on ribbon fiber
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We introduce a wavelength demultiplexer operating with multimode waveguides of rectangular geometry matching ribbon fibers. This eliminates the spatial-spectral mixing at output waveguide coupling. Performance is stretched between the need to separate wavelengths and modes.

articleTitle: A 12-rack, 180-server datacenter network (DCN) using multiwavelength optical switching and full stack optimization
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We present DFabric, a 12-rack, 180-server DCN using multiwavelength switching and interconnection. DFabric implements real-time network traffic and per-link utilization monitoring, and full-stack optimization by jointly optimizing optical switching and network flow routing.

articleTitle: Polarization insensitive fiber optical parametric amplifier using a SBS suppressed diversity loop
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We suppress stimulated Brillouin scattering occurred in a polarization diversity loop by restricting pumps propagation in highly nonlinear fibers to one-way so that we obtain fine polarization insensitive operation of a fiber optical parametric amplifier.

articleTitle: Direct measurement of transverse mode correlation and fiber-enhanced RIN through MMF using 850nm VCSELs
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Cross-correlations between VCSEL transverse modes are synchronously observed and used to predict kmpn and dispersion dependent RIN. Experiments with MMF of different dispersion slope confirm importance of reach-dependent RIN currently neglected in the IEEE model.

articleTitle: Few mode multicore photonic lantern multiplexer
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate an all-fiber multi-mode, multi-core photonic lantern mode multiplexer for SDM applications. Selective excitation of 21 spatial channels, LP<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">01</sub> and LP11<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">a,b</sub> modes in 7 cores, with insertion losses below 0.4dB is obtained.

articleTitle: Investigation of performance-enhanced ROADMs for N-WDM superchannels carrying high-order QAM
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Adding a ring-resonator-assisted MZI for preprocessing improves the selectivity of ROADMs, enabling cascades of ROADMs to process N-WDM superchannels. We experimentally investigate the N-WDM superchannels performance with high-order QAM after filtered by cascaded enhanced ROADMs.

articleTitle: Components for 100G coherent pluggable modules — CFP2
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We review recent advances in components for coherent pluggable modules with focus on CFP2-ACO. Key requirement for these components are compact size, low power, low cost and richness in functionality.

articleTitle: High-capacity and high-spectral-efficiency seamless fiber-wireless system for high-speed trains
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose a dual-hop network to high-speed trains by using a seamless fiber-millimeter-wave system for backhaul transmission and a high-speed in-train network. Transmission of a 64-QAM OFDM signal over the cascaded system is successfully confirmed.

articleTitle: Ultra-high-speed all-channel serial-to-parallel conversion based on complete optical fourier transformation
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose a serial-to-parallel conversion scheme based on complete OFT, allowing simultaneous conversion of all channels. We demonstrate all 32-channel simultaneous OTDM to WDM conversion of 320-Gbit/s DPSK and of 640-Gbit/s DQPSK signal, respectively.

articleTitle: FTTU: MSO perspective
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Summary form only given. The cable industry has been deploying fiber optic cable for over 25 years, running triple play bundled service for most of those years. The industry has also been deploying fiber-to-the-premises to commercial customers for many years. And, with respct to residential fiber, MSOs have taken a lead role in defining next generation EPON standards as part of the IEEE 803.xyz activities and developed SCTE 174, also known as the standard defining RF over Glass (RFoG). Lastly, of course, the industry is introducing the most advanced residential copper technology in the form of DOCSIS 3.1 over its massively deployed Hybrid Fiber-Coax infrastructure. What has been behind each of these initiatives is that Internet traffic continues to grow exponentially, year on year. It has been driven by video over the last several years (i.e. Netflix, Hulu, etc) and it is anticipated that IoT applications will be what continues to drive this growth trend going forward. In addition to the requirements for new capacity, MSOs have to also consider competitive market speeds, as non-traditional providers attempt to penetrate the space with promises of higher and higher speeds. To meet this demand, multiple technology options are becoming available to support both residential and Commercial customers. Among these are the aforementioned DOCSIS 3.1, Point-to-Point Fiber solutions (Ethernet), Point-to-Multipoint Fiber solutions (xPON), optical advances in modulation and WDM, and even wideband wireless technologies. There is no one-size-fits-all solution, and the use of multiple technologies allows MSOs to optimize services to customers while keeping the architecture ahead of the capacity and speeds demands projected.

articleTitle: Experimental nonlinear frequency domain equalization of QPSK modulated 2-eigenvalue soliton
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Second order soliton with independently QPSK-modulated discrete spectral amplitude was transmitted over 1600-km in an NZ-DSF loop and distortion of spectral phase was mitigated by applying back-rotation proportional to error of pre-decided eigenvalues.

articleTitle: Downstream transmission of pre-distorted 25-Gb/s Faster-than-Nyquist PON with 10G-class optics achieving over 31 dB link budget without optical amplification
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate 25-Gb/s downstream transmission over 20-km SSMF in a Faster-than-Nyquist PON with 10G-class optics based on pre-distorted NRZ, achieving −26 dBm receiver sensitivity and over 31 dB loss budget without any optical amplification.

articleTitle: Simplified impulse response characterization for mode division multiplexed systems
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We present a single transceiver based modal characterization method for estimating the channel impulse response of MDM systems. Good agreements are found between the measured and simulated DGDs of a RCF supporting 5 mode groups.

articleTitle: First 4×4 InP switch matrix based on third-order micro-ring-resonators
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A first of its kind InP switch circuit is implemented using a matrix of 4×4 third-order ring resonators. Broadband routing is demonstrated at 10Gbps and 20Gbps with a maximum power penalty of only 2.6dB.

articleTitle: Trellis coded modulation transmission over 40km 6-LP mode fiber
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate transmission of trellis-coded-modulated-12-spatial-and-polarization modes over 40km 6-LP-mode fiber with low differential mode group delay. By employing 8-PSK trellis coded modulation, an OSNR gain of 1.8dB is observed in comparison to QPSK.

articleTitle: Simultaneous 12-passband microwave photonic multiband filter with reconfigurable passband frequency
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A reconfigurable microwave photonic multiband filter with up to 12 simultaneous passbands is demonstrated. Both the passband frequencies and passband numbers are adjustable, and each passband has a sidelobe suppression of over 35 dB.

articleTitle: FlexEthernet Eutoriai
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: •Enable flexibility on Ethernet interface: Custom rates Efficient LAG Match transport bandwidth Unbounded MLG Channelization Increase interface reliability Break Ethernet and transport roadmap marriage •Ready to be adopted on 100GE interface Faster Ethernet rates added in future versions.

articleTitle: Photonic downconversion and optically controlled reconfigurable antennas in mm-waves wireless networks
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We report on optically controlled antennas and photonic downconversion for mm-wave wireless communication applications. Experimental results demonstrate a transmission of 1.25 Gb/s using 28 and 38GHz frequency bands.

articleTitle: Optical spatial division multiplexing for ultra-high-capacity modular data centers
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose and evaluate four optical interconnect architectures based on spatial division multiplexing for ultra-high capacity modular data centers. It is shown in which way the best option depends on the network load and size.

articleTitle: Spectrally efficient Nyquist-WDM PDM-64QAM signal generation using interleaved DAC with zero-order holding
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We investigate Nyquist spectral shaping using two-channel-interleaved DAC with zero-order holding for Nyquist-WDM 64QAM systems, which requires FIR filter with 57 taps, bandwidth of 0.4-0.6 times of the symbol rate, and DAC resolution >7 bits.

articleTitle: On the benefits of few-mode transmission in ring metro optical networks with flexible grid
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: For RSA optimization in few-mode flexi-grid rings, we derive distance-adaptive reaches for low MIMO complexity transceivers up to 5 modes and optimally solve the problem under two different assumptions on spatial flexibility.

articleTitle: Compact grating coupler for thick silicon nitride
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Thick Silicon nitride-on-insolater (SNOI) is widely used for nonlinear applications due to its broadband nearly-zero flattened dispersion. In this paper, we present a grating coupler for strip waveguides on 700-nm-thick SNOI. Focusing grating structure and inverse taper are combined to minify the footprint to 70μm × 19μm. The peak couplin g efficiency is -3.7dB and the 1-dB bandwidth is 54nm.

articleTitle: Germanium-on-silicon photo-detectors based on tiny micro-disk resonators
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Micron-scale disk resonators are explored to minituarize and enhance Ge-on-Si photodetectors. A 2.0 μm-radius detector exhibits a dark current of 11 nA, a responsitivity of 0.5 A/W and a 3-dB bandwidth of 17 GHz at -1V bias.

articleTitle: Bismuth-doped optical fiber amplifier and watt-level CW laser for the spectral region 1600–1800 nm
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: The first bismuth-doped fiber amplifier (BDFA) for 1640-1770-nm region was developed. The BDFA diode-pumped at 1550 nm is characterized by 23-dB peak gain at 1710 nm, noise figure~7 dB, Δλ<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1/2</sub>=40 nm and g=0.1 dB/mW.

articleTitle: 28-Gb/s × 24-channel CDR-integrated VCSEL-based transceiver module for high-density optical interconnects
publicationTitle: 2016 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate a very high density 28-Gb/s × 24-channel CDR-integrated VCSEL-based optical transceiver module. The optical module achieves a very high data rate density of 1344 Gb/s/inch<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> (2.08 Gb/s/mm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>). An optical link employing the optical module achieved a jitter margin of 0.48 U.I. at a BER of 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-12</sup> at case temperatures ranging from 31 °C to 70 °C with a very low link power of 13.5 mW/channel/Gb/s.
